• Konzeption, Design und Realisierung anspruchsvoller Embedded-Software in C/C++ für unsere Mess- und Sensorsysteme

• Erarbeitung von Systemarchitekturen, technischen Konzepten und Spezifikationen sowie Gestaltung komplexer Software- und Hardwarefunktionen

In our R&D group, we develop hearing solutions and services for hearing impaired people and hearing care professionals in the form of hearing instruments, accessories, web services, mobile applications and PC software.

In a team of electrical and software engineers, you will contribute to the design, development and maintenance of modern C++ embedded software and tools.

The development is focused on hardware abstraction embedded C++ software to abstract the multi-processor hardware for efficient embedded software application development and specific applications for production tests.

Your work will build the foundation for all Sonova hearing instrument product applications, developed by Sonova teams worldwide. From the engineering to mass-manufacturing phase, you will be engaged in contributing highly flexible and reliable embedded software solutions.

More about the role :

•
Develop reliable, high-performance, real-time embedded software in modern C++ from hardware abstraction layers to production test application logic

•
Contribute to the specification and design of embedded software for production tests and test flow configuration.

•
Contribute to workflow and process improvements

•
Create reusable embedded software and tools which are used by interdisciplinary engineering teams

•
Close collaboration with engineers across disciplines in product and platform teams

•
Contribute to our agile development process through implementation, code reviews and continuous improvement

More about you :

•
MSc or BSc in electrical engineering, computer science or comparable qualifications

•
Strong expertise in embedded software engineering, including RTOS, concurrency and distributed systems

•
5+ years of professional experience in C and C++; experience with modern C++ standards, including C++23, is a plus

•
Strong understanding of object-oriented design and its application in embedded and resource-constrained environments

•
Experience with Python and/or C#.NET

•
Experience or interest in AI coding agents, continuous integration, and automated test frameworks

•
A structured, methodical approach and a passion for solving complex technical problems

•
Fluent in English; German is a plus

More about what we offer :

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges where every byte of memory matters?

As an Embedded Software Engineer C++, you will join an experienced team focused on developing deeply embedded firmware for our next generation of hearing devices (medical devices).

This is an opportunity to apply your deep C++ expertise in embedded development. You will work close to the hardware, navigate complex, state-of-the-art development and test environments, and solve challenging problems across the boundaries of software, tooling and hardware.

More about the role

• Develop object-oriented embedded software in modern C++ for resource-constrained wireless hearing devices.

• Contribute to the design and architecture of new functionality, working closely with software architects and interdisciplinary platform teams.

• Develop, document, test, integrate and maintain software throughout the development lifecycle, while ensuring appropriate test coverage and reliable system behavior.

• Debug complex issues directly on target hardware and in simulators.

• Work within state-of-the-art development, build and test environments and contribute to their continuous improvement.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across mobile and desktop software, firmware, verification and requirements engineering to bring new hearing solutions from concept to product.

More about you

• You have excellent embedded software C++ development know-how, including operating systems, concurrency, communication, distributed systems, and object-oriented design, combined with 5+ years of professional experience.

• You have developed software for highly resource-constrained systems, with limited memory and battery power.

• You are skilled in debugging and comfortable investigating complex issues on actual hardware, including situations where the root cause may lie in software, hardware or the development environment.

• You are familiar with modern embedded software engineering practices and development environments and continuous integration. Knowledge of Python, C#, test frameworks or related tooling is an advantage.

• You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, the natural sciences, or a comparable technical discipline and communicate confidently in English; knowledge of German is a plus.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

description.value:
**Your job**

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples:

* low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges
    
* context-switch-free code
    
* design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint
    
* data pipelines using a streaming paradigm
    
* complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time
    
* re-implement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)
    

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants.

**Who are you**

Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset:

* extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux
    
* an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write
    
* understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost
    
* knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently
    
* understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)
    
* ability to work with debuggers and profilers
    
* operative coding (git, documentation)
    
* ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team
    
* pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant
    

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

* experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations
    
* experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases
    

**  
What we offer**

* Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus)
    

* Fun and inspiring work environment
    

* Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues
    

* 25 vacation days
    

* Additional benefits: going out for dinner regularly, Friday afternoon drinks, yearly office trip(s), weekly massages, monthly meal allowance

Job Description

We are seeking a Data Modeler for the P&C domain to join our Tech, Data & AI team. The successful candidate combines data modeling skills with a good understanding of (re)insurance processes. You bring the ability to translate functional requirements into structured, scalable, and business-aligned data models.

This position goes beyond pure technical modeling: it requires ownership of how (re)insuance data is represented across systems, ensuring consistency, traceability, and alignment with enterprise standards to support reporting, closing, planning, and decision-making.

Key duties and responsibilities

Under the responsibility of the P&C Lead Data Engineer, your mission will be to:
Design, build, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for P&C within the Data Foundation (Databricks & Palantir Foundry), supporting reinsurance processes such as underwriting, pricing, claims.

Develop and evolve analytical data models that enable scalable reporting, self-service analytics, and AI-driven use cases.

Contribute to the enterprise P&C data model, ensuring consistent business definitions and alignment across domains and systems

Collaborate with Data Engineers, Architects, and P&C stakeholders to ensure models reflect business semantics and integrate into the overall data architecture.

Ensure data consistency, reconciliation capability, and proper handling of granularity, time dimensions, and historical tracking in financial datasets.

Support metadata management, business glossaries, and data lineage in collaboration with data stewards to provide transparent and governed P&C data.

Apply and promote data modeling standards and best practices to improve quality, reusability, and maintainability of P&C data assets

Required experience & competencies
Experience in data modeling or data engineering, with a focus on understanding conceptual, logical, and physical models.

Experience building analytical data models for reporting and analytics.

Proficiency in SQL and/or PySpark, with understanding of modern data platform architectures.

Experience in the insurance industry or in financial services is a strong plus.

Experience with Databricks and/or Palantir Foundry is a plus.

Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.

Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to structure complex topics.

Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Excellent communication skills and ability to operate in an international, matrix environment.

As a leading global reinsurer, SCOR offers its clients a diversified and innovative range of reinsurance and insurance solutions and services to control and manage risk. Applying “The Art & Science of Risk,” SCOR uses its industry-recognized expertise and cutting-edge financial solutions to serve its clients and contribute to the welfare and resilience of society in around 160 countries worldwide.

Working at SCOR means engaging with some of the best minds in the industry – actuaries, data scientists, underwriters, risk modelers, engineers, and many others – as we work together to find solutions to pressing challenges facing societies.

As an international company, our common culture is defined by “The SCOR Way.” Serving both to build momentum that drives the Group forward and as a compass to guide our actions and choices, The SCOR Way is anchored by five core values, reflecting the input of employees at all levels of the Group. We care about clients, people, and societies. We perform with integrity. We act with courage. We encourage open minds. And we thrive through collaboration.

SCOR supports inclusion and the diversity of talents, and all positions are open to people with disabilities.

Für unsere Mandantin, eine etablierte und wachstumsstarke Anbieterin im Bereich Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende, kommunikativ starke “Hunter”-Persönlichkeit für den gesamtschweizerischen Markt. Die Rolle ist **hybrid** ausgelegt: Sie arbeiten flexibel aus dem Home Office, sind regelmässig bei Kunden und Partnern vor Ort und nehmen an internen Abstimmungen sowie Teammeetings teil.

### Ihre Aufgaben:

* Aufbau und Pflege von strategischen Key Accounts auf C-Level (z.B. im Umfeld von institutionellen Anlegern, Pensionskassen, u.ä.)
    
* Frühe Positionierung bei Investoren und Entscheidungsträgern entlang neuer Bau- und Infrastrukturprojekte

* Identifikation und Entwicklung von Geschäftspotenzialen in der gesamten Schweiz
    
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachabteilungen sowie Übergabe an nachgelagerte Vertriebseinheiten (z.B. Planerberatung)
    
* Führung anspruchsvoller Verkaufsprozesse (von Verhandlungen bis zum Vertragsabschluss) mit technischem Tiefgang
    
* Marktbeobachtung sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Vertriebsstrategie im C&I-Umfeld
    

### Ihr Profil:

* Abgeschlossene höhere Ausbildung (FH/HF/Uni) im technischen oder betriebswirtschaftlichen Bereich, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Immobilien, Energie oder Gebäudetechnik

* Unternehmerisches Denken, Abschlussstärke und Freude an aktiver Marktentwicklung
    
* Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Eigenverantwortung
    
* Deutsch auf Mutterspracheniveau, Französisch und Englisch verhandlungssicher
    
* Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Schweiz
    

### Unsere Mandantin bietet:

* Eine Schlüsselrolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf die Marktentwicklung
    
* Innovative Lösungen in einem zukunftsorientierten, nachhaltigen Marktumfeld bei einem technischen Marktführer
    
* Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybridmodell (Home Office / Aussendienst / Teammeetings)

## Company Description

Talan est un groupe international de conseil et d’expertises technologiques, qui accompagne et accélère la transformation digitale de ses clients par les leviers de la technologie, de la data et de l’innovation.

Depuis plus de 20 ans, Talan conseille et accompagne les entreprises et les institutions publiques dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation et d'innovation en Suisse et à l'international.

Présent sur 5 continents dans 21 pays, le Groupe, certifié Great Place To Work, compte plus de 7000 collaborateurs.

Doté d'un Centre de recherche et d'innovation, Talan met l'innovation au cœur de son développement et intervient dans les domaines des mutations technologiques telles que l'Intelligence Artificielle, la Data Intelligence, la Blockchain, pour servir la croissance des grands groupes et des ETI dans une démarche engagée et responsable.

En plaçant la “Positive Innovation” au cœur de sa stratégie, Talan est convaincu que c’est en étant au service de l’humain que la technologie amplifie son impact sur la société tout entière.

#TalanSuisse

## Job Description

Au sein de l’équipe Digital Development, vous pilotez techniquement la conception, le développement et l’évolution d’applications digitales dédiées à la gestion de fortune (*Wealth Management*).

En tant que **Tech Lead Fullstack**, vous êtes le référent technique de votre périmètre. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de développement, du frontend au backend, tout en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité et la performance des applications. Vous accompagnez les développeurs, contribuez aux choix d’architecture et participez activement aux mises en production ainsi qu’au support applicatif.

Responsabilités principales

* Définir les orientations techniques et les architectures applicatives.
* Participer au développement fullstack et à la résolution des problématiques techniques complexes.
* Accompagner les développeurs, réaliser des revues de code et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques.
* Garantir la qualité, la sécurité, la performance et la maintenabilité des applications.
* Contribuer à l’industrialisation des développements, aux pipelines CI/CD et aux déploiements.
* Participer aux mises en production

Compétences techniques

* **Backend :** C#, .NET, API REST et architectures microservices.
* **Frontend :** Angular, React ou Vue.js.
* **Bases de données :** Microsoft SQL Server.
* **DevOps / DevSecOps :** Azure DevOps, Git, SonarQube, CI/CD.
* **Conteneurisation :** Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift.
* **Déploiement :** Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD.
* **Infrastructure :** Windows Server et IIS.
* Sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité applicative et de confidentialité des données.

## Qualifications

* Expérience confirmée en développement fullstack et solide expertise .NET / C#.
* Capacité à prendre des décisions techniques, à accompagner une équipe et à travailler de manière autonome.
* Excellent esprit d’analyse, pragmatisme, rigueur et sens des responsabilités.
* **Excellente résistance au stress**, capacité à gérer les priorités, les urgences et les contraintes de délais dans un environnement exigeant.
* Bon relationnel, communication constructive et capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés.
* **Français et anglais courants, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.**
* Une expérience dans le secteur bancaire ou la banque privée constitue un atout.

## Additional Information

📍 Localisation : **Résidence en Suisse souhaitée.**

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

### The Position

Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is the center of excellence for the development and support of all customer and patient-facing digital products in the Roche Group. Our global team of digital experts and enthusiasts develops and commercializes data-driven solutions to deliver on the ambition of building a sustainable digital health business. Together we provide differentiated patient monitoring solutions for chronic conditions; shape clinical workflows and lead the market of Clinical Decision Support; and are THE digitalization partner for in-Vitro Diagnostics.

### The Opportunity

* Act as a strategic business leader and People & Culture (P&C) partner for RIS, bringing an entrepreneurial mindset to shape the long-term strategic direction.
    
* Apply system thinking and partnership across the whole P&C model to diagnose, prioritize, initiate, sponsor, and drive holistic P&C solutions at enterprise, divisional, and organizational levels.
    
* Serve as an influential member of the RIS Leadership Team, the Business Partnering Enabling Team (BPET), and the Diagnostics People & Culture Enabling Team (Dia PCET).
    
* Business Acumen: Translate the business vision and P&C goals into actionable projects and initiatives with clear milestones, utilizing organizational and external knowledge to diagnose complex issues and recommend improvements.
    
* Leadership: Provide key leadership in complex P&C needs for the Division and Roche Group overall, operating at the same level as the Diagnostics Leadership Team (DLT) members you partner with.
    
* Architectural Strategy: See unlocking moves and architect holistically, connecting P&C expertise and solutions directly with business needs.
    
* Coaching & Influence: Serve as a strategic sparring partner and coach, fostering VACC leadership and influencing business leaders to drive positive impact.
    
* Strategic P&C Insights & Innovation: Leverage technology to gather insights, research, metrics, and benchmarks to make informed decisions and recommend innovative solutions.
    

### Who you are

You are a strategic, forward-thinking leader with a strong growth mindset and learning agility, capable of embodying and promoting Roche's Operating Principles to drive meaningful cultural change. You are deeply committed to putting patients first, following the science, acting as one team, embracing differences, accelerating learning, simplifying radically, making an impact now, and thinking long term. With your exceptional influencing, communication, and facilitation skills, you effortlessly build trust and foster collaboration across highly complex, global matrix environments.

Furthermore, you bring the following qualifications and experiences:

* Seasoned P&C professional with demonstrated experience in shaping P&C strategies across diverse business areas.
    
* Proven track record of successfully partnering with and coaching senior leaders.
    
* Extensive experience and passion for building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing organization.
    
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and navigate the complexity of multiple business areas and global teams.
    
* Strong potential and readiness to take on broader P&C roles in the future.
    

Are you ready to shape the future of People & Culture and make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

### Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

  

We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world.

That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.

**We are Roche.**

Are you inspired by the idea of shaping the technological future of Zurich and setting the architectural direction for one of our most important strategic initiatives? Do you enjoy navigating complex solution landscapes and designing robust, future-proof architectures? Then this is the right place for you!

In this role, you will be part of the Information & Technology business unit within P&C Transformation and actively help shape the continued development of Zurich Switzerland.

Become part of the most important strategic P&C initiative, where future products, processes and technologies are being built. As a Solution Architect, you take on a key role in the end-to-end solution design across all Guidewire Centers (Jutro Digital Platform, PolicyCenter, BillingCenter) as well as adjacent Zurich Solutions. You ensure architectural consistency, drive sound technical decision-making, and make sure our solutions comply with Zurich's architecture standards (e.g. ASD42).

What you can expect

• Take ownership of the end-to-end solution design across all Guidewire Centers (Jutro Digital Platform, PolicyCenter, BillingCenter) and adjacent Zurich Solutions

• Ensure architectural consistency and compliance with Zurich's architecture standards (e.g. ASD42) across the entire solution stack

• Evaluate solution alternatives and make well-founded technical decisions in close collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, Security and delivery teams

• Translate complex business requirements into end-to-end solution designs and guide them from concept to successful implementation

• Act as the central point of contact for architectural topics, working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, development teams and external partners

What makes you stand out

• A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable qualification, combined with several years of experience as a Solution Architect in an agile insurance environment

• Proven, hands-on experience with Guidewire systems (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, Jutro Digital Platform, Integration Gateway) and their integration into complex IT architectures – ideally at an international insurer such as Zurich

• Solid expertise in integration architectures, API design, cloud technologies (Azure and/or AWS) and common architecture frameworks (e.g. arc42/ASD42, TOGAF)

• Strong analytical and conceptual skills, paired with a structured, decisive way of working and the ability to communicate technical topics to different audiences

• Very good command of English and/or German (C1/C2 level)

Good to know

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Work location : Oerlikon, Zurich

Start date: From 01.12.2026 or by agreement

Travel: None

Hybrid working: Up to 40%

Everything about your application

Das ist noch nicht alles – bei uns erwarten Dich 40 Wochenarbeitsstunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit von Remote zu arbeiten.

Du fühlst Dich angesprochen? Unser Team wächst stetig und wir suchen Dich als **Software Engineer** **(m/w/d)** bevorzugt an unserem Standort **Jona** oder alternativ **Basel**, um unsere Kunden gemeinsam bestmöglich zu beraten und zu unterstützen.

### **WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST**

* Konzeption, Implementierung und Integration moderner Applikationen mit C# und .NET
* Aufnahme und Analyse von Anforderungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Product Manager
* Entwicklung hochwertiger und benutzerfreundlicher Softwarelösungen
* Qualitätssicherung auf Basis interner Richtlinien und Standards
* Technische Beratung und kompetente Ansprechperson bei fachlichen Fragestellungen

**WIE DU UNS BEGEISTERST**

* Fachhochschulabschluss und praktische Erfahrung sowie Interesse an IT-Sicherheit, Authentisierung, digitalen Signaturen und Verschlüsselung
* Fundierte Kenntnisse im Software Engineering, C# und der aktuellen .NET-Plattform sowie Kenntnisse in Blazor, .NET Aspire, Wolverine sowie weiteren Sprachen wie Java oder Go
* Erfahrung mit der Implementierung von Webapplikationen, Webservices, Benutzeroberflächen, Datenbanken und Backend-Systemen
* Analytisch-konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, schnelle Auffassungsgabe, Kommunikationsstärke sowie gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

**FEEL GOOD KULTUR @SITSGROUP**

* **Wertschätzung:** Eine offen-herzliche, respektvolle und wertschätzende Kommunikationskultur steht bei uns an erster Stelle.

title.value: Exklusiv - Business Manager (a) im Software Enticklungsumfeld mit C-Level Perspektive

description.value:
Zeit für eine Veränderung? Wir finden für Sie den passenden Job!

Auf Grund von unserer Kompetenz und Erfahrung verstehen wir beide Seiten: Sie als Bewerber und die Arbeitgeber und bringen, mit modernster digitalen Tools, die zwei zusammen, die die gleichen Vorstellungen vom Arbeitgeber, dem Job, der Kultur, der Vergütung und weiteren wichtigen Aspekte haben. Eine effiziente, digitalisierte und nachhaltige Vermittlungsstrategie sind unsere Schlüsselwerte.

Du bist Macher, verstehst IT und denkst unternehmerisch?

Für ein innovatives Schweizer Unternehmen suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Business Manager (a) mit der Perspektive, mittelfristig Verantwortung auf C-Level zu übernehmen.

Diese Position ist bewusst stark operativ ausgerichtet. Wir suchen keine Person, die aus der Distanz Konzepte entwickelt, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die im Tagesgeschäft Verantwortung übernimmt, Entscheidungen trifft, führungsstark Mitarbeiter und Kunden begleitet sowie gemeinsam mit dem Team Lösungen umsetzt.

Aufgaben

Als Business Manager übernimmst du Verantwortung für das operative Funktionieren und die Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens.

Du bist nahe am operativen Geschäft, kennst die Anforderungen der Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte und Lösungen erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei verbindest du dein technisches Verständnis mit deiner langjährigen Erfahrung in der betriebswirtschaftlichen Unternehmensführung .

Du packst an, übernimmst Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass aus Anforderungen konkrete Ergebnisse werden.

Dazu gehören unter anderem:

• Operative Unternehmensführung und Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft

• Führung, Begleitung und Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden

• Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen und deren kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung

• Sicherstellung einer hohen Kundenorientierung und Qualität der erbrachten Leistungen

• Verantwortung für die Wirtschaftlichkeit und effiziente Gestaltung der operativen Abläufe

• Begleitung und Beurteilung von Geschäftsfällen, Angeboten und Kundenprojekten

• Koordination der verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und Spezialist

• Unterstützung bei Personal-, Organisations- und Führungsfragen

• Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von internen Prozessen

• Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen im laufenden Geschäft und deren konsequente Umsetzung

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung bei unternehmerischen Fragestellungen

• Übernahme von Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von Entscheidungen, nicht nur deren Konzeption

• Aktive Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft und bei wichtigen Kunden- und Unternehmenssituationen rungs- und Unternehmensverantwortung mit Perspektive C-Level

Qualifikation

Deine IT- und Business-Kompetenz

Du kommst ursprünglich aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich fachlich in Richtung Wirtschaftsinformatik und Unternehmensführung weiterentwickelt.

Du verstehst deshalb beide Seiten:

Technologie und Business.

Du kannst mit Entwickler über technische Zusammenhänge sprechen, verstehst gleichzeitig betriebswirtschaftliche Auswirkungen und kannst diese Perspektiven für Kunden und Mitarbeitende zusammenbringen.

Erfahrung in einem Softwareentwicklungsunternehmen, das seine Lösungen auch selbst bei Kunden implementiert , ist von grossem Vorteil.

Ausbildung

• Lehre als Programmierer EFZ

• Weiterbildung idealerweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik

• Führungsweiterbildung

Erfahrung

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer verantwortungsvollen Position und 10+ Jahre fundierte Praxiserfahrung , davon mehrere Jahre in der ERP-Implementierung

• Langjährige Erfahrung in der betriebswirtschaftlichen Unternehmensführung

• Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden

• Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt und in der Betreuung von Geschäftskunden

• Praxiserfahrung in einem Softwareentwicklungsunternehmen, das ihre Softwarelösungen selbst entwickeln und beim Kunden einführen

Deine Persönlichkeit

Du bist kein klassischer Verwalter.

Du bist eine unternehmerisch denkende Macherpersönlichkeit , die Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge umsetzt.

Du kannst Prioritäten setzen, Entscheidungen treffen und Menschen dafür gewinnen.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Kunden, Mitarbeitende und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und verstehst, dass ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen nur funktioniert, wenn Menschen, Leistung, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit zusammenspielen.

Dabei bist du:

• lösungsorientiert und entscheidungsfreudig

• kommunikativ und überzeugend

• selbstständig und verantwortungsbewusst

• führungsstark und gleichzeitig teamorientiert

• pragmatisch und umsetzungsorientiert

• technisch affin und betriebswirtschaftlich versiert

• kundenorientiert und unternehmerisch denkend

• einsatzfreudig und zielorientiert

Sprachen

• Schweizerdeutsch: Muttersprache

• Deutsch: Muttersprache

• Englisch: sehr gute Kenntnisse

• Französisch: gute Kenntnisse

Benefits

• Eigenständiger Arbeitsbereich mit entsprechender Verantwortung sowie mittelfristige Entwicklung in den C-Level

• Verantwortung für ein Team und das weitere Wachstum zusammen mit dem Team

• Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz mit guter ÖV-Anbindung im Kanton Zug

• Diverse Team- und Firmenanlässe

• Übernahme zusätzlicher Sozialversicherungskosten

• 5 Wochen Ferien (gleitendes Arbeitszeitmodell)

Haben Sie Lust das Wachstum unserer Partnerfirma mitzuprägen?
Dann freuen wir uns bald von Ihnen zu lesen.

(a) steht für alle und heisst, dass bei uns alle willkommen sind, wir Diversität lieben und gegen jegliche Diskriminierung sind.

Es können nur Direktbewerbungen akzeptiert werden.

description.value:
Quantum Digital begeistert Unternehmen mit integrierten Kommunikationslösungen und unterstützt diese langfristig bei deren Auftritt am Markt. Wir verbinden Technologie- mit Designverständnis und entwickeln smarte Lösungen für eCommerce und crossmediales Marketing.

Die Systeme verarbeiten Informationen aus Business-Anwendungen wie ERP oder CRM, automatisieren Prozesse, um unterschiedlichsten Output zu erstellen und Benutzern über CMS und Apps zur Verfügung zu stellen. Für einen Teil der Kunden betreiben wir die Software-Lösungen im eigenen Rechenzentrum. Dabei setzen wir auf moderne Technologien und auf Mitarbeitende, die sich aktiv einbringen und weiterentwickeln.

Aufgaben

Du betreust in einem dynamischen Team einen der grössten B2B Shops in der Schweiz. Du realisiert webbasierte Applikationen im Microsoft- (.NET, C# etc.) und Coldfusion/Microsoft-SQL-Umfeld. Deine Aufgaben sind vielseitig und abwechslungsreich. Du klärst Anforderungen ab, entwirfst Lösungskonzepte, arbeitest beim Erstellen der Software-Architektur mit, realisierst und testest neue Applikationen. Dabei bist du in alle Phasen der Software-Entwicklung involviert bis zur Einführung beim Kunden. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und dich selbständig in neue Fachgebiete einarbeiten. Je nach Projektanforderung werden unterschiedliche Technologien eingesetzt.

Qualifikation

Du hast Erfahrung in der Software-Entwicklung mit einer webbasierten Sprache, bevorzugt ColdFusion oder PHP sowie den Datenbanken Microsoft-SQL oder MariaDB. Gleichzeitig bist du interessiert, dich in neue Fachgebiete einzuarbeiten und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Kenntnisse weiterer Programmiersprachen, vor allem c# sowie der Tools/Methoden JIRA, Confluence, Scrum oder vergleichbare sind von Vorteil. Es kommt sowohl eine erfahrene Person wie auch ein begeisterter Junior in Frage. Als Junior hast du entweder eine höhere Ausbildung abgeschlossen und suchst deine erste Stelle, oder Du bist Applikationsentwickler mit Berufserfahrung. Wichtig ist, dass du Freude an der Software-Entwicklung hast und gerne Neues lernst.

Benefits

• Du profitierst von einem erfahrenen und engagierten Team in
einem jungen Unternehmen und entwickelst in einem modernen Umfeld anspruchsvolle Lösungen in direktem Kontakt mit unseren Kunden.

• Hilfsmittel wie JIRA, Confluence, Slack sowie nach Wunsch Mac oder PC etc. unterstützen das kollaborative und effiziente Arbeiten.

• Du arbeitest in einer flachen Hierarchie, erhältst Einblick in die geschäftlichen Abläufe und bestimmst Entscheidungen mit.

• Dich erwarten Eigenverantwortung und die Möglichkeit den Arbeitstag eigenständig zu planen, Lunch & Learn Sessions, bezahlte Parkplätze, fünf Wochen bezahlter Urlaub, 13. Monatslohn sowie flexible Jahresarbeitszeitmodelle.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und geben dir gerne weitere Informationen.

## Unternehmensbeschreibung

Unser Kunde ist ein modernes Digital/Tech Unternehmen. Die Firma kreiert innovative Lösungen für externe Kunden aus den Bereichen Banking, Insurance, Government, Transport, Industrie und Retail.  
Mit drei Standorte in der Schweiz (**Zürich, Bern, Basel**), hybride Arbeitsmodelle und Liquid Arbeitspensum zählt die Firma zu den besten Arbeitgebern in der Schweiz.

Im Rahmen eines starken Wachstums suchen wir Dich als  
             **Mid-Senior FullStack ( C#.NET/JavaScript) Engineer (m/w/d).**

Arbeitsmodell: hybrid – 1-2 Tage im Office, **bis zu 3 Tage remote. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit möglich.**

## Stellenbeschreibung

**Die Position:**  
  
Du erweiterst und verbesserst die bestehenden Produkte oder entwickelst neue, innovative Lösungen für die vielfältigen Kunden aus den Bereichen Banking, Retail oder Government.   
Dich erwartet eine kollegiale Atmosphäre und eine tolle Arbeitsplatzkultur!

**Verantwortlichkeiten:**

•    Durchführung von projektvorbereitenden Tätigkeiten, Reviews, Requirements Engineering, Prototypen, etc.  


## Qualifikationen

**Dein Profil:**  
  
•    (Fach-) Hochschulabschluss in Informatik  
•    Stilsicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift  
•    Flexibilität, Einsatzbereitschaft und Interesse am Umgang mit Kunden und Mitarbeitenden  
•    Ausgewiesene Berufserfahrung  
•    Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Konzeption, Design und Umsetzung von Front-end-Lösungen mittels modernen Web-Technologien (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript)

•    Erfahrung mit Unit- und e2e-Testing Tools wie Jest, Karma, Jasmine, Protractor oder ähnlichen Tools  
•    Erfahrung in .NET-Technologien mit Schwerpunkt C#

•    Bestellung von privaten Notebooks.  
•    Autoflottenrabatt.  
•    Weiterbildung: eigene interne Academy, Onsite- und Onlinetrainings.  
•    Unbezahlter Urlaub jederzeit möglich.  
•    Familienfreundliches Unternehmen: Spass für Dich und deine Familie in der Freizeit - Gratisbesucherkarten für den Zoo, oder Spiel und Spass im Museum  
•    Täglich frische Äpfel im Büro, Kaffee, Wasser und Bier – selbstverständlich gratis.  
•    Top ausgezeichnetes Unternehmen mit wunderbarer Arbeitspolitik und –kultur.

• Ein höfliches Auftreten und eine freundliche Kommunikation

DAS BIETEN WIR
• Freu Dich auf mehr als nur ein attraktives Gehalt - eine leistungsorientierte Vergütung mit einem festen Grundgehalt

• Baue Dein Netzwerk aus - durch standortübergreifenden Austausch und Zusammenarbeit

• Gestalte Deine Karriere aktiv - mit echten Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen innerhalb der Gruppe

• Plane langfristig - mit der Sicherheit und Stabilität eines etablierten Unternehmensverbunds

Wenn Du bereit bist, in einem langjährigen, motivierten Team mitzuwirken und gerne vielseitige und interessante Aufgaben löst, sind wir die richtigen Ansprechpartner für Dich.

ÜBER DIE GARLA GRUPPE
Wir, die GarLa Gruppe , sind eine führende Unternehmensgruppe im Garten- und Landschaftsbau mit einer dynamisch wachsenden Zahl spezialisierter Firmen in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. Gegründet 2019 zählen wir heute mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden zu den führenden Akteuren im deutschsprachigen Raum.

Unsere Strategie: nachhaltiges Wachstum durch Akquisitionen, gemeinsamer Wissenstransfer und die Schaffung einer starken, vernetzten Gruppe mit hoher regionaler Kompetenz.

Wachse über Dich hinaus. Mach Deine Karriere in der GarLa Gruppe.

Neugierig geworden? Erfahre noch mehr über unsere Gruppenstruktur, unsere GarLa Unternehmen und die aktuellen Jobangebote: https://garla-gruppe.com/karriere/

WHO WE ARE

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/, Windows https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/, iOS https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/, and Android https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/, our search engine https://duckduckgo.com/, and the DuckDuckGo subscription https://duckduckgo.com/pro. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai https://duck.ai/, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

YOUR TEAM AND ROLE

Working on the C++ Functional Team, you'll build the high-performance code at the core of DuckDuckGo's browser using modern C++ and Chromium, and work on related projects.

You can expect to work on projects like:

- Implement tracker blocking that stops hidden trackers on every site without slowing page loads.

- Bring VPN and Personal Information Removal into the browser through the DuckDuckGo subscription.

- Catch startup and responsiveness regressions automatically, so the browser stays fast as it grows.

As a Senior C++/Chromium Engineer, you'll lead complex projects from proposal through post-mortem. You'll turn vague problems into clear plans, build them in a large modern C++ codebase, and use metrics to show they worked. Some days that means low-level systems work. Others, it means architecture decisions the whole team builds on. You'll collaborate with design and product, mostly asynchronously, to build features people use to protect their privacy.

ABOUT YOU

- Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact, complex projects from proposal through post-mortem

- Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics

- 7+ years of software engineering experience

- Advanced modern C++ expertise (C++23 or newer), including memory management, concurrency, and performance profiling

- Experience driving technical work end-to-end on large-scale C++ codebases

- Comfort with large build systems, debuggers, and profilers

- Experience shipping software to a large consumer audience

- Solid computer science foundation (algorithms and data structures)

- Bonus: Windows development experience

- Bonus: experience with browsers (Chromium, WebKit, WebView), game engines, or large desktop applications

COMPENSATION

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

- United States: $190,500 USD annually

- United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP annually

- Canada: C$253,500 CAD annually

- Europe/Rest of World: €157,350 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our Team Member Support Guide https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

HIRING PROCESS

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

PLEASE NOTE THAT:

- You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

- Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

- While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

- A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

- By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

- Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/files/pages/careers/DuckDuckGo-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-effective-September-30-2025.pdf. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

- Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

- Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

description.value:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for enabling the executive(s) to function at their best, by performing a variety of administrative, logistical and project management related tasks.

## **YOUR CHALLENGE**

* Act as first point of contact for internal stakeholders across all levels of the organization and external clients / partners
    
* Provide administrative assistance, such as writing and editing e-mails, drafting memos and preparing communications on the executive’s behalf
    
* Manage the executive’s calendar, including scheduling appointments and travel and prioritizing the most sensitive matters
    
* Organize internal and external meetings including telephone and video conferencing with a large number of stakeholders
    
* Plan and manage business trips including travel planning such as flights, hotels, transfers and expense reports
    
* Research, support and manage smaller projects and prepare of content for miscellaneous topics
    

## **YOUR PROFILE**

* Extensive experience in supporting senior leaders at board level
* Discreet and trustworthy individual with absolute dedication to confidentiality
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to communicate successfully with various internal and external stakeholders on all levels of the organization
* Strong time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work
* Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
* Attention to detail and problem solving skills
* Proficient user in MS Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint
* Relevant higher educational and professional background

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our [Career site](https://juliusbaer.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/External).

Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a **job alert** by creating a candidate account [here](https://juliusbaer.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/External/jobAlerts).

  

**The** **international reference in wealth management**

Julius Baer is the leading Swiss wealth management group. We focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients from around the world, taking into account what truly matters to them – in their business and personal life, today and for future generations.

Headquartered in Zurich, we are present in around 60 locations worldwide, including Dubai, Dublin, Frankfurt, Geneva, Hong Kong, London, Lugano, Luxembourg, Madrid, Mexico City, Monaco, Mumbai, Santiago de Chile, Shanghai, Singapore, and Tel Aviv.

**Why join Julius Baer?**

At Julius Baer our employees enjoy the benefits of a global company with the support and collegiality of a much smaller one. We are growing quickly, but we remain dedicated to maintaining our accessible structure with flat hierarchies, and approachable and supportive leaders.

With offices around the world, we offer an international and stimulating work environment and the opportunity to work with a diverse team of highly motivated colleagues, bringing the best of the bank to our clients.  Our core values of Care, Passion, and Excellence define the tone of how we interact with each other and our partners.

**Committed to your success**

Whether nurturing young talent with our renowned apprentice scheme, enabling ambitious university graduates to put theory into practice with our Graduate Programme, or providing first-class opportunities for experienced professionals, we look after our employees. We believe in continuous learning as a company and as individuals, which is why we put a focus on the health and well-being of our employees and offer flexible working options, a wide array of benefits, and extensive career development programmes.

For more information visit [www.juliusbaer.com](http://www.juliusbaer.com/) or contact us via the  [Contact](https://www.juliusbaer.com/en/contact/) [Form](https://www.juliusbaer.com/en/contact/).

For recruiting agents, please see the additional information [here](https://www.juliusbaer.com/en/careers/).

Join our Engineering team in Visp as an EI&C MES DeltaV Application Manager 80-100% (m/f/d) and drive the evolution of our MES DeltaV (formerly Syncade) landscape across its full lifecycle. In this role, you’ll shape digital manufacturing by leading MES projects, strengthening system standards, and ensuring GMP‑compliant, high‑impact system performance.

  

*This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.*

  

## **What you’ll get:**

  

* An agile career and dynamic working culture
* An inclusive and ethical workplace
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance
* In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on: [Benefits - Visp](https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597)

  

## **What you’ll do:**

  

* Execute and lead MES DeltaV projects across all lifecycle phases, including requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
* Maintain, optimize, and further develop MES standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and alignment with site and global guidelines.
* Ensure reliable operation, enhancement, and updating of MES DeltaV (formerly Syncade) systems, recognizing their direct impact on production processes and GMP‑compliant documentation.
* Collaborate closely with Operations, QA, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless system integration and high system availability.
* Analyze and improve MES‑related workflows, identifying opportunities for digitalization, efficiency gains, and data integrity improvements.
* Coordinate and manage external partners and vendors involved in MES or OT‑related project and support activities.
* Ensure GMP‑compliant execution of all MES and OT activities, including documentation, change control, and validation readiness.

  

## **What we are looking for:**

* Completed university degree in Computer Science, Industrial IT/OT, Automation Engineering, or a related field (Bachelor level or higher).
* Significant professional experience in IT/OT, MES DeltaV (formerly Syncade), or automation‑related engineering roles within a regulated environment.
* Solid understanding of GMP requirements and experience working with validated production or automation systems.
* Responsibility for the MES lifecycle, including system operation, enhancements, release management, and interface coordination.
* Strong knowledge of OT networks, virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware), system architectures, and basic cybersecurity principles.
* Fluent German or English (minimum B2 level) for effective collaboration with local and global stakeholders.
* Structured, independent working style with strong communication and problem‑solving skills.
* Willingness to participate in on‑call duty (Pikettdienst) 2-3 times per year.

  

## **About Lonza:**

  

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

  

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

  

**Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.**

  

  

Every day, our teams across the world work together to turn scientific breakthroughs into life-changing medicines that reach up to 100 million patients a year. Lonza is a place where people can make a unique impact, grow their careers and belong.

**You will feel at home at Lonza if you:**

* Take ownership, step forward, and enjoy meaningful responsibility
* Love solving problems and thrive in a complex, fast-moving environment
* Are curious, always looking to learn and improve
* Work collaboratively, contributing to something bigger than yourself
* Are motivated to make a difference through work that impacts customers and their patients

**Why Lonza:**

We are a place of unique opportunity, where your ideas, expertise and ambition can make a real difference. Here, you will have the freedom to grow, the support to succeed and the chance to contribute to work that matters.

  

**We are the makers of the medicines of tomorrow.**

  

**Join us. Be you. Apply Now**

description.value: Als (Technical) Product Owner:in führst du ein cross-funktionales Team aus internationalen IT-Entwickler:innen, Architekt:innen, Tester:innen, Business Analyst:innen und Requirements Engineers. Du verantwortest dabei die Weiterentwicklung unserer Anwendungslandschaft im P&C Nicht-Leben, vom Kernsystem über IT-Schnittstellen bis zu kundennahen Tools und Versicherungsprodukten. Dabei bringst du Business, Architektur und Technologie zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Anforderungen funktionierende Lösungen mit echtem Kundennutzen werden. Du nutzt gezielt AI, um Anforderungsmanagement, Entwicklung und Testing schneller, intelligenter und effizienter zu machen und inspirierst dein Team sowie das Umfeld, diesen Ansatz mitzutragen. Du willst nicht nur ein Backlog managen, sondern prägen, wie agile Teams Lösungen entwickeln? Dann bist du bei uns richtig! Das kannst du bewirken Du führst das Team fachlich, priorisierst den Backlog konsequent nach Wert und Abhängigkeiten und sorgst dafür, dass die richtigen Lösungen bei Underwriting, Kund:innen und Partnern ankommen Du gestaltest und verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von Kernsystem, IT-Schnittstellen und Tools und behältst dabei das Zusammenspiel der Systeme im Blick Du treibst den Einsatz von AI im gesamten Entwicklungsprozess aktiv voran,von der Erhebung der Anforderungen, über Requirements Engineering bis zum Testing und etablierst ein progressives AI-First-Mindset im Team Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zu Stakeholdern aus Produktmanagement, Underwriting, Betrieb, Governance, Architektur und IT-Partnern und übersetzt fachliche und technische Anforderungen präzise in technische Lösungen Du steuerst und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit mit Internationalen-Entwicklungsteams und schaffst die Voraussetzungen für schnelle, qualitativ hochwertige Releases Du bringst neue Versicherungsprodukte, Produktanpassungen und weitere Lösungen effizient auf die Strasse und bist treibende Kraft für eine moderne, zukunftsfähige Systemlandschaft Das bringst du mit Einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fachgebiet Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und produktiven Umsetzung von AI-, Automatisierungs- oder Softwarelösungen sowie gutes Verständnis für Lösungsarchitekturen, APIs, Systemintegrationen und Datenflüsse sowie kenntnisse des Versicherungsgeschäfts von Vorteil Erfahrung als Product Owner:in oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Fach und IT in agilen Teams; auch Quereinsteigende mit starkem technischen Hintergrund willkommen Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams von Vorteil Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools sowie Freude am Experimentieren mit neuen Ansätzen und Technologien. Erfahrung mit Generative und Agentic AI von Vorteil Klare und überzeugende Kommunikation sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu begeistern und Teams fachlich zu führen Stilsicheres Deutsch und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse Hast du Fragen zur Stelle? Yasmin Samadian, Talent Sourcing & Recruiting Manager, Telefon, 058 358 75 59, steht dir gerne zur Verfügung. Wir freuen uns über deine Online-Bewerbung mit aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Diplomen). Darum startest du mit uns «Let’s care for tomorrow» heisst für uns auch, ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, das die Individualität unserer Mitarbeitenden berücksichtigt: Mit der Möglichkeit von Jobsharing, mit 8 Wochen Vater- und 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub, der Option, 10 zusätzliche Ferientage pro Jahr zu kaufen, bis zu 25 Tagen pro Jahr im Ausland zu arbeiten, vielseitige Weiterbildungen und weiteren Benefits. Die Fürsorge für unsere Mitarbeitenden, ihre Ambitionen, Träume und Herausforderungen macht uns zu einem einzigartigen Arbeitgeber. Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Bestreben: Unsere Kunden stehen an erster Stelle und im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Ihre Bedürfnisse inspirieren unser Denken und leiten unser Handeln. Gemeinsam können wir ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem sich jeder motiviert und gestärkt fühlt, eine bessere Zukunft zu gestalten und zu formen – für unsere Kunden und für unsere Gesellschaft. Bei der Allianz stehen wir für Einheit: Wir glauben, dass eine geeinte Welt eine prosperierende Welt ist, und wir setzen uns konsequent für Chancengleichheit ein. Die Grundlage dafür ist unser integrativer Arbeitsplatz, an dem sowohl Menschen als auch Leistung zählen und wo Integrität, Fairness, Inklusion und Vertrauen im Mittelpunkt unserer Kultur stehen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller ethnischen und kulturellen Hintergründe, Altersgruppen, Geschlechter, Nationalitäten, Religionen, sozialen Herkünfte, Menschen mit oder ohne Behinderung sowie unterschiedlicher sexueller Orientierung und anderer durch lokale Gesetze und Vorschriften geschützter Merkmale. Strategy Officer, SIED - GL C - Defined Duration until December 2029 & Defined Duration until December 2028 (2 positions)

Reporting to the Advisor, Strategy Development, the Strategy Officer, supports the development and evolution of the Global Fund’s six-year Strategy and policies through high-quality research, analysis, coordination, and development of strategic materials.  
  
The role supports Strategy development, undertaking research and analysis on relevant global health, financing and development issues and synthesizing evidence and stakeholder perspectives to inform strategic choices and decision making. It also supports analysis and delivery across strategy or policy priorities, working with relevant teams to develop evidence, assess options and implications, and support the development, review and evolution of organizational positions and policies.  
  
Working as part of the Strategy, Policy & Partnerships team, the Officer supports internal and external consultations and the preparation of materials for senior management and governance, working closely with colleagues across the Secretariat to deliver Strategy and policy priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Undertake high-quality information gathering and analysis in the fields of public health and development to support the development of the Global Fund Strategy.
* Undertake landscape analyses of current issues and/or challenges in the fields of HIV, TB, malaria, health systems and development indicators, and benchmarking for high-level multi-year strategies.
* Prepare for and support high-level meetings with key stakeholders from across the Global Fund partnership, including developing background materials, conducting outreach, synthesizing outcomes and developing reports.
* Synthesize conclusions and key strategic takeaways from a wide range of discussions, evidence and written input.
* Support development of succinct and strategic materials to guide stakeholder input and decision-making on topics relevant to strategy development and ongoing updates in organizational strategic direction.
* Work with stakeholders across Secretariat Divisions to obtain and synthesize input on topics relevant to strategy development and organizational strategic direction.
* Contribute to drafting Board and Committee presentations and materials.
* Support relevant teams across the Secretariat to prepare for new Strategy operationalization and changes in organizational strategic direction including but not limited to Global Fund funding model ,the allocation methodology, KPIs,  the grant lifecycle and Secretariat operations.
* Undertake other tasks as required relevant to the day-to-day work of the Policy & Strategic Investment department .

*Subject to change by the Executive Director at any time at their sole discretion.*

  

**Qualifications**

  

**Essential:**  
First degree in public health, international development, development economics, business administration or a related field;

  

**Experience**

  

**Essential:**

* Relevant work experience, ideally within an international management consultancy, public health or development organization, major multilateral or bilateral organization, not-for-profit or related setting.
* Experience and familiarity with key indicators, information sources and organizations in international development, HIV, TB, malaria, systems for health and development.
* Demonstrated understanding of topics and innovations at the forefront of international development, particularly HIV, TB, malaria, resilient and sustainable systems for health and other relevant sectors.
* Experience distilling and synthesizing the key strategic points of research, analysis, written input and extended discussions.
* Experience drafting concise reports capturing the key salient points of extensive discussions or meetings.
* Experience developing high-quality presentations to effectively communicate strategic messages based on analysis or stakeholder input.
* Experience with effective stakeholder engagement in complex organizational processes.
* Experience with responsible use of AI tools in research and evidence synthesis.

  

**Desirable:**

* Over 2 years relevant professional experience within an international management consultancy, public health or development organization, major multilateral or bilateral organization, not-for-profit or related setting.
* Experience working in a health or development program in a developing country.
* Experience and familiarity with the Global Fund, its funding model and operations.

  

**Competencies**

  

**Languages:**

Excellent knowledge of English and preferably good working knowledge of French. Knowledge of other languages would be an asset.

**Functional Competencies:**

* Analytical (Mastery)

* Business (Foundation)
* Geopolitical Awareness (Mastery)
* Global/Public Health (Mastery)
* Multicultural Understanding (Mastery)

description.value:
Who are we?
SOLEVO is a leading distributor of chemicals and inputs for specific industrial and agricultural segments in Africa. SOLEVO assists African farmers and Industries succeed by providing them with a full range of fertilizers, seeds, crop protection products and industrial chemicals they need with a guaranteed quality and good value. With over 75 years at the frontier of economic growth and transformation across Africa, we deliver critical raw materials and expertise to the continent's high GDP-contributing life sciences and industrials sectors.

What are we looking for?
We are seeking an experienced and talented Group Compensation & Benefits Manager & HR Business Partner to join our Group Human Resources team, based at our headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. He/she should have a strong compensation & benefits background in an international, multi-country environment, hands-on HR generalist experience in Switzerland, and be fluent in English and French.

What do we expect from the candidate?
The Group C&B Manager & HRBP will design, implement and govern the compensation and benefits framework of the SOLEVO Group across all subsidiaries in Africa. The goal is reward practices that are competitive, fair, cost-controlled and compliant in every country. The role is the Group reference for all reward matters and partners closely with Regional and Country HR Managers, Finance and Management. In addition, the position acts as HR Business Partner for the Geneva headquarters and the UAE office, managing the full employee life cycle, recruitment and payroll for Switzerland and the UAE. Reporting to the Group HR Director, the role manages the Group Comp & Ben Officer.

The key responsibilities:

• Design and update Group reward policies (salary, incentives, benefits, allowances, mobility) and build the Group job architecture: job families, grades and salary bands per country. This includes leading job evaluations with a recognised methodology (e.g. Mercer IPE, Korn Ferry/Hay).

• Define approval rules and delegation of authority for pay decisions, advise HR Managers on offers, promotions and pay adjustments, and prepare remuneration papers for the COMEX and, where applicable, the REMCO.

• Assess the Group incentive structure to ensure it fits the business strategy, and design and administer short-term incentive, bonus and commercial incentive schemes. This covers target setting, payout calculation and harmonisation across countries.

• Coordinate the annual salary review for all Group entities through Compport, and run salary benchmarking exercises with reward consultancies and salary survey providers.

• Monitor inflation and exchange rate movements in volatile markets (e.g. Nigeria, Egypt, Ghana, Angola) and propose adjustment mechanisms. Partner with Group Finance on personnel cost budgets, forecasts and actuals.

• Produce reward dashboards and analytics (compa-ratios, pay positioning, cost of benefits, gender and internal equity) for the Group HR Director, Finance and COMEX.

• Oversee Group benefits programmes (medical, life and disability insurance, pension plans), building a Group-wide view of insurance providers and vendors and leading renewals and tenders. Define and apply the Group mobility policy.

• Support HR due diligence and the harmonisation of grades, pay structures, benefits and incentive plans of acquired entities with Group standards.

• Act as HR Business Partner for HQ Switzerland and the UAE office. This covers recruitment, onboarding, contracts, internal mobility, offboarding, work permits and visas, as well as advising senior leaders and COMEX members on people matters.

• Execute the monthly Swiss payroll via the external provider and oversee UAE payroll, managing Swiss social insurances (AVS/AI/APG, AC, LPP, LAA, IJM) and UAE statutory benefits (WPS, end-of-service gratuity).

• Manage and develop the Group Comp & Ben team, lead the administration of Compport and ensure the quality and integrity of compensation data in the HRIS.

If you possess…
Must-Have:

• Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related field.

• 5–7 years of HR experience, including at least 3 years in compensation & benefits in an international, multi-country environment.

• Hands-on HR generalist experience in Switzerland, including Swiss payroll and social insurances, and solid knowledge of Swiss labour law.

• Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured reporting and dashboards for Management.

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, and experience with HRIS and compensation management tools.

• Fluency in English and French.

Nice-to-Have:

• Compensation & benefits certification (e.g. WorldatWork CCP/GRP).

• Exposure to UAE HR and payroll practices.

• Experience working with African countries and in multi-currency, high-inflation environments.

• Experience with Compport or a similar compensation platform.

• Knowledge of data protection rules applicable to HR data (Swiss FADP / GDPR).

If you are…

• A person of high integrity, able to handle confidential data with absolute discretion.

• Rigorous and detail-oriented, with strong business acumen.

• Able to advise and influence senior managers and HR counterparts remotely across countries.

• Adaptable, hands-on and proactive, comfortable working in multicultural and geographically dispersed teams.

Why join Solevo?

• Join a young, dynamic team leading chemical distribution on the African continent.

• Enjoy a collaborative, international and agile work environment.

• Be part of a team where freedom, initiative and "thinking out of the box" is key.

• Opportunity to work in a growing, versatile environment.

• Competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits package.

• Explore opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

Then, this job is for you!

How to join us?
If you're excited about this position, we encourage you to submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and be part of our exciting journey.

What's next ?
If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for a first contact.
Please be informed that we will keep your profile to contact you for future professional opportunities.

Département

HUMAN RESOURCES

Location

Genève · Solevo Suisse

About SOLEVO

Join Solevo: Empowering Progress Across Africa
At Solevo, we connect communities and industries with the solutions they need to grow, thrive, and transform. From supporting agricultural self-sufficiency to driving industrial innovation, we are shaping the future of Africa’s life sciences and industrial sectors.
