title.value: Associate Specialist, Services Procurement (SI), Supply Operations - GL C - Defined Duration until December 2029

description.value:
Associate Specialist, Services Procurement (SI), Supply Operations - GL C - Defined Duration until December 2029

The Global Fund aims to accelerate the end of AIDS, tuberculosis (TB) and malaria as epidemics. As part of our mandate to fight the three diseases, the Global Fund plays a leading role in global markets for medicines and technologies that prevent, diagnose, and treat HIV, Tuberculosis and Malaria. Every year, more than half of the Global Fund’s investments is used to procure key health products, ensuring they are available to those who need them most.  
  
As one of the biggest health product procurement entities in the public sector, investing nearly US$3 billion in health products and equipment procurement, the Global Fund is uniquely placed to drive equitable access to quality-assured health products, services and innovations through its Supply Operations department.  
  
Supply Operations, collaborating across the Global Fund Secretariat, is responsible for the Global Fund’s market shaping activities and the overall management of procurement activities, health product sourcing, quality assurance and supply chains.  
  
The Sourcing team is a strategically integrated function responsible for all procurement activities across all spending categories, including health and non-health products and services, with a combined annual spend exceeding US$2 billion. It encompasses the sourcing of health products such as pharmaceuticals, diagnostics and health technologies, and vector control, as well as the sourcing of non-health products and services, including third-party managed services such as procurement service agents (PSAs), IT services, HR and professional services and other Secretariat operational and managed procurement spending.  
  
The Non-Health Products and Services Sourcing team is responsible for managing the procurement of services and non-health product categories across the Global Fund Secretariat, including procurement services, professional services, IT, facilities, and other operational support. This includes the category strategy, supplier performance management and contract management of outsourced procurement service providers such as Procurement Service Agents (PSAs), UN agencies, GDF and others, who support the Pooled Procurement Mechanism (PPM) and broader sourcing operations and it includes the procurement of services to deliver Strategic Initiatives (SI) financed through Catalytic Investment, Set-Aside, and other targeted investments.  
  
Under the supervision of the Senior Specialist, Services Procurement (SI), the Associate Specialist, Services Procurement (SI) supports the operational delivery of services procurement for Strategic Initiatives, with an estimated spend of up to USD 500M in GC8. Working under the direction of the Senior Specialist, the role ensures that SI related procurements are executed in a timely, compliant, and well coordinated manner, enabling effective delivery of Strategic Initiatives.  
  
The role focuses on the day to day, end-to-end execution and administration of services procurements, while contributing to monitoring, reporting, in coordination with CI PMO and internal stakeholders. It plays a key role in ensuring predictability, quality, and transparency across SI financed procurement activities and works closely together with key SI stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Procurement Management**

**1\. Operational delivery of SI services procurement**  
Manage SI‑related services procurements end‑to‑end under supervision, including preparation of solicitation documents, coordination of procurement processes, and execution of tenders in line with approved sourcing approaches, for a total volume of up to USD 500M.

**2\. Tender administration and evaluation support**  
Support the administration of RfPs and other solicitation processes, including coordination of TECs, management of vendor communications, documentation of evaluations, and preparation of award materials.

**3\. Stakeholder coordination**  
Coordinate with the CI PMO, SI teams, Finance, Legal, and vendors to support smooth execution of procurement activities and timely resolution of operational issues.

**4\. Tracking, monitoring, and reporting**  
Track procurement milestones, contract status, and utilization of SI‑financed services, contributing data and inputs to absorption monitoring and reporting to CI PMO and management.

**5\. Process discipline and compliance**  
Apply Global Fund procurement policies, procedures, and tools consistently, ensuring high‑quality documentation and flagging risks, delays, or deviations for escalation.

**6\. Continuous learning and improvement**  
Contribute to improving SI procurement delivery by identifying operational efficiencies, capturing lessons learned, and strengthening execution practices.

*Subject to change by the Executive Director at any time at their sole discretion.*

**Qualifications**

**Essential:** University degree in business administration, procurement and supply chain management, public health, or a related field.

**Desirable:** Professional Certifications in Project/Supply Chain/ Procurement/Contract Management/Negotiation

**Experience**

**Essential:**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement and sourcing.
* Demonstrated experience managing procurement services and/or indirect spend categories (e.g., technical assistance, professional services).
* Experience implementing procurement policy, ensuring compliance and implementing performance frameworks.

**Desirable:**

* Experienced working in a matrix organization
* Familiarity with the Global Fund’s operating model, governance and sourcing frameworks
* Working experience in health product procurement and supply chain management with Low Middle-Income Countries

**Competencies**

**Languages:**

An excellent knowledge of English and preferably a good working knowledge of French. Knowledge of other languages would be an asset.

**Functional Competencies:**

* Analytics (Level 2)
* Business (Level 3)
* Country Context (Level 1)
* Finance (Level 2)
* Geopolitical Awareness (Level 2)
* Negotiations (Level 2)
* Operational Policy (Level 2)
* Procurement & Supply Chain (Level 3)
* Project Management (Level 2)

Program Officer, RSSH & PPR, Strategy, Investment & Evidence Division - GL C - Defined Duration until December 2028 x 2 positions

In GC8 the Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health and Pandemic Preparedness and Response (RSSH-PPR) team will be responsible for managing >US$50M in Strategic Initiatives and Gates funded grants across a variety of different thematic areas including integrated services, human resources for health, surveillance, lab systems strengthening, digital and climate and health.  
  
Reporting to the Deputy, RSSH & PPR, the Program Officer is responsible for supporting RSSH & PPR technical teams with the effective set-up, management, and closure of GC8 Strategic Initiatives and Gates funded grants. This includes planning, third-party supplier sourcing, contract management, financial management and internal and external reporting.  
  
The Program Officer will be part of a small team providing cross-cutting support and will need to work flexibly across the different RSSH & PPR sub-teams, responding to different priorities and to peaks and troughs in demand. The Program Officer will need to be comfortable managing a fluid workload, whilst simultaneously maintaining a forward look and supporting the different sub-teams to anticipate and plan for emerging priorities.  
  
The Program Officer will need to work closely with stakeholders from various different teams and departments, including technical teams, Sourcing, Finance, CI PMO, GMD and the Chief of Staff’s partnerships team.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Supporting different RSSH&PPR sub-teams, and working across different GC8 SIs and Gates grants, the Program Officer will be responsible for:

  

Sourcing and funds integration

  

* Coordinate sourcing and contracting working with Sourcing, Finance, Legal and CI PMO, maintaining a continual lens on value for money and operational feasibility.
* Develop procurement strategies and develop terms of reference.
* Coordinate RFQ/RFP processes.
* Provide support for the finalization of contract documents, including payment schedules and payment conditions.
* Provide support to the grant revision process to integrate private donor funding to grants.

  

Progress monitoring and performance management

  

* Maintain project plans, deliverable trackers and / or other tools needed to monitor the progress of SIs and Gates funded grants.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and routinely share updates on progress, including third-party supplier delivery against contractual milestones, with technical advisors and team leads to ensure early issue identification and to support problem solving.

  

Contract and financial management

  

* Serve as the administrative focal point for the third-party suppliers as well as representatives from collaborating institutions.
* Focal point for financial management of GC8 SIs including:
    * forecasting, and quarterly accruals monitoring;
    * tracking and follow up on financial commitments/invoices, validating final invoices based on reports and deliverables and support Budget Holder to approve final invoices
    * tracking and follow-up on cash balances in collaboration with CI PMO Finance focal point
    * monitoring of Purchase Orders,
    * implementing all other activities related to financial reporting including project closure in line with relevant guidelines and operating procedures.

  

Reporting

  

* Coordinate internal reporting to key stakeholders including routine reporting to CI PMO on the Results Framework.
* Coordinate reporting on financials to key stakeholders including the budget holder, CI PMO and Finance (amounts allocated, approved, disbursed, remaining to commit, etc.).
* Provide support to ensure private donor funding to grants is delivered in line with expected target.  This includes engagement with Country Teams and regular monitoring of investments.
* Support technical advisors and team leads with coordinating reporting for external stakeholders, including private sector donors and Global Fund governance bodies.

  

Team support

  

* Coordinate inputs for routine team meetings.
* Organize and coordinate workshops, meetings, conferences, and tele-conferences and manage related logistics.
* Support other communication efforts as needed including brown bags, info sessions, e-learning tools.

  

Knowledge management and continuous improvement

  

* Work in collaboration with the other Program Officer(s) to ensure the continuous improvement of key support processes including progress monitoring and contract and financial management. This includes standardizing processes across SIs and Gates grants in line with best practice and to facilitate more flexible use of capacity.
* Maintain a structured database of all relevant SI and Gates grants materials to ensure transparency and accessibility.

  

*Subject to change by the Executive Director at any time at their sole discretion.*

  
  

**Qualifications**  

**Essential:**  
University degree in Public Health, Business Administration, or equivalent.

  
  

**Experience**  

**Essential:**

  

* Experience working in the Global Fund either in an SI management, grant management, financial or procurement role.
* Familiarity with the Global Fund’s financial and sourcing procedures and processes.
* Demonstrated project management or project coordination experience.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
* Analytical capacity and experience working with both programmatic and financial data.
* Proven communication and data presentation skills.
* Stakeholder management experience and the ability to work with diverse stakeholder groups to deliver results.

  

**Desirable:**

  

* Over 2 years of relevant work experience. 
* Experience working in international development / public health.
* Experience working with third-party supplier / technical assistance providers.
* Experience working in countries where Global Fund invests.

  
  

**Competencies**

  

**Languages:**

  

An excellent knowledge of English and preferably a good working knowledge of French. Knowledge of other languages would be an asset  

**Functional Competencies:**

  

* Strengthening Systems for Health - Foundation
* Project Management - Mastery

## **Job Description:**

For over 150 years, our dedication to being the [Global Hausbank](https://www.db.com/who-we-are/strategy/index?language_id=1&kid=strategy.redirect-en.shortcut) for our clients has been driven by our people – in around 60 countries and across more than 150 nationalities. Their deep understanding, insights, expertise, and passion help our clients navigate an increasingly complex world – be it in our Corporate Bank, our Private Bank, our Investment Bank or our Asset Management division. Together we can make a great impact on our clients homes and abroad, securing their lasting success and financial security.

Deutsche Bank’s Wealth Management business is one of the largest wealth managers worldwide. We offer our clients a broad range of traditional and alternative investment solutions, as well as comprehensive advice on all aspects of Wealth Management. As a trusted partner of wealthy individuals and entrepreneurs, family offices and foundations, we create lasting value for clients. We specialize in developing bespoke solutions for our clients around the world, for instance wealth planning across successive generations and international borders, asset management with individual risk management, loans and deposits.

We aim to become a highly competitive global wealth manager by combining financial strength and stability with trustworthy partnership and forward-thinking in order to build sustainable and beneficial client relationships. As a growth business for Deutsche Bank, we contribute towards building a more balanced, less capital intense and stable business model for the bank.

You as a Relationship Manager are the primary point of contact for clients to access the entire suite of wealth management capabilities and solutions offered by Deutsche Bank Wealth Management. This is achieved by working in close partnership with the Investment Manager (IM) in the day-to-day planning and servicing for the client. You are responsible for acquiring new clients - who are in line with the business proposition of the bank - and assets as well as grow existing business relationships, assuring a holistic and high-standard client experience.

As a Relationship Manager, you are part of a highly dynamic team and play an instrumental role in executing our growth strategy targeting Swiss (U)HNW clients (onshore), Entrepreneurs, Single/Multi Family Office and institutional investors.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify, develop, acquire and maintain HNW/UHNWIs, Entrepreneurs, Single/Multi Family Office and institutional investors
    
* Increase share of wallet /Assets under Management by undertaking a business development, sales or relationship management approach as appropriate
    
* Responsible for the overall Net New Assets creation and revenue generation on the respective books in a scalable and efficient way
    
* Balance client relationship, prospect building, investment growth, administrative compliance, personal growth and development on a day-to-day and longer-term basis
    
* Plan and manage resources (time, budget) to run an optimal business
    
* Work in close co-operation with other coverage, product and support functions to deliver DB’s value proposition, leveraging also other DB divisions where possible, namely Corporate Business, Investment Banking and Asset Management (DWS)
    
* Recommend investment products, credit solutions and services that are suitable for clients based on their objectives, resources, time, horizon, risk profile and preferences
    
* Review client portfolios periodically to ensure the portfolio performance is aligned with clients’ investment objective and risk profile
    
* Partner with IMs in covering clients to discuss/manage financial goals, risk tolerance, research/analyze market conditions, provide bank views of various investment types, recommend asset allocation and provide explanation on how they benefit/hinder investment objectives
    
* Act as the Accountable Client Owner with responsibility for all AML aspects of the client relationship; including KYC and account behavior
    
* Establish and maintain relationships with the management teams and informing management of any circumstances that require supervisory attention/review/approval as per compliance guidelines and policies
    
* Actively support the business / growth strategy, plans and values, new products and services, contributing to the achievement of a high performing team
    
* Participate in relevant client social events as well as in PR and other marketing activities
    
* Timely follow up, completion of various Key Risk Indicators highlighted locally and by the Booking Centre - periodic KYC reviews, Document deficiencies, cross border travel/meeting call reports portfolio reviews etc.
    
* Awareness of local compliance and regulatory requirements
    
* Document quality notes in a Call Report after prospect/client calls/meetings, summarizing discussions, additional actions required, including follow-up calls
    
* Build and maintain existing client relationships. Ownership of relationship process (from initiation to closure)
    

Skills

* Master’s degree with a background in Finance preferable
    
* Certified Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or Master of Business Administration (MBA) is desirable 
    
* At least 10  years of financial services experience as a Client Relationship Manager
    
* Fluency English is a prerequisite, additional C&EE language (esp. Polish) a significant asset
    
* Credible financial services experience as a Client Relationship Manager, preferably in the HNW/UHNWI segment
    
* Sound understanding of the Swiss private banking market as well as the current business of C&EE region (esp. Poland)
    
* Strong and natural interest in financial markets
    
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
    
* Client-oriented, solution-oriented and able to work in a high paced environment under pressure
    
* Superior investment acumen and solid network of clients in the target coverage market is required
    
* Good understanding of Governing Regulatory Framework
    
* Strong Collaboration skills and excellent communication skills with a positive approach
    
* Professional integrity
    
* Ability to manage resources and allocate them for most effective use
    
* Willing and able to develop other staff
    

Well-being & Benefits

* Emotionally and mentally balanced  
    We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.
    
* Physically thriving  
    We support you managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive.
    
* Socially connected  
    We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self confidence and well being.
    
* Financially secure  
    We support you to meet personal financial goals during your active career and for the future.
    

We strive for a [culture](https://careers.db.com/this-is-db/index?language_id=1) in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

## **The future looks like you**

Nous recherchons un Store Visual Merchandiser CDI 100% au magasin C&A de Balexert.

Date d'entrée  : 01.12.2026

Depuis sa création par les frères Clemens et August en 1841, C&A a été un précurseur dans la mode. De l'introduction du prêt-à-porter à l'époque où le sur-mesure était la norme, à la popularisation des mini-jupes dans les années ‘60, en passant par l'introduction du Com-Bi-Kini dans les années ‘70, le coton bio au début des années 2000 et jusqu’au premier vêtement certifié « Cradle to Cradle Gold » en 2017, nous avons toujours évolué avec notre temps, rendant possible des vêtements élégants et de qualité pour tous. Et alors que C&A et le monde qui nous entoure ont changé au fil des décennies, une chose est restée la même: notre engagement à proposer une mode durable et de qualité pour toute la famille.   
Nous souhaitons pour l'avenir une industrie de la mode qui soit plus innovante et plus durable, qui se dirige vers un avenir circulaire et qui favorise un cycle d'utilisation, de réutilisation et de renaissance des vêtements.  
En Suisse, C&A est représentée par plus de 90 magasins et emploie plus de 1’300 personnes.

## **Vos responsabilités**

* Réalisation de l’identité visuelle du magasin
* Création des vitrines selon les directives centrales
* Présentation optimale des produits en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de magasin et l'équipe de vente
* Ambassadeur de notre marque

## **Votre profil**

* Passion pour la mode et les gens
* Flexible en matière d'horaires de travail
* Très bonne capacité de communication
* Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en tant que Visual Merchandiser

## **Ce que nous vous offrons**

* Un environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique
* 30% de réduction dans tous nos magasins
* 20% de réduction dans notre boutique en ligne
* Portail d'avantages avec offres de grandes marques
* Bonus et compensation des heures supplémentaires
* 5 semaines de vacances
* Culture du feedback et possibilités de développement

Operations Officer, Investment Oversight - GL C - Defined Duration until December 2029 x 3 positions

Reporting to the Specialist, Design, Optimization and Operations Management, the Operations Officer is responsible for providing a range of services across Funding Request, Grant-Making and Portfolio Optimization design, compliance and quality assurance, with responsibilities shifting or evolving in focus according to business priorities. The incumbent is expected to provide effective and timely support across any of these areas, and to assist fellow Operations Officers within the Investment Oversight team during periods of workload peaks or absences, ensuring continuity and consistency of service delivery. The role requires high standards of precision, compliance orientation and quality assurance in policy, process and applicant-facing guidance, combined with the agility to manage multiple concurrent workstreams under the tight deadlines and cyclical pressures of TRP submission windows and GAC review meetings. The Operations Officer is a member of the Investment Oversight team within the Policy and Strategic Investment Department, and works across teams and workstreams to support efficient, high-quality investment decision-making from funding request through to grant award and portfolio optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Under the day-to-day supervision of the Specialist, Design, Optimization and Operations Management, the Operations Officer will be responsible for one or more of the following areas, while assisting other Operations Officers in the Investment Oversight team with their responsibilities during periods of peak workload or absences. Responsibilities may shift or evolve in focus according to business priorities; hence, each Operations Officer is expected to provide effective and timely support in any of the following:

**Funding request & Grant-making design, compliance and quality assurance**

* Maintain and update OPNs, procedures and due diligence screening guidelines in relation to TRP and GAC, covering areas such as Portfolio Optimization, Program split, Allocation Utilization Period (AUP) and CCM eligibility differentiation.
* Develop and maintain guidance materials for applicants, the Secretariat, and partners, including: (i) templates and guidance to be made available simultaneously with application materials and (ii) Modular Framework, Performance Framework and other programmatic guidance materials so that requirements are clear and consistently applied.

  

**Eligibility screening and governance coordination**

* Compile and maintain lists of applicants by type, including existing and prospective non-CCM applicants for the allocation period
* Carry out differentiated screenings against CCM Eligibility Requirements 1 and 2, escalating unresolved issues to Investment Oversight Management. Convene the Compliance Review Panel (CRP) to confirm applicant types and the CCM screening approach
* Support the preparation of allocation letter templates and customized allocation letters to be issued to applicants.

  

**Portfolio optimization (PO) delivery**

* Support the design of Portfolio Optimization processes, tools and systems, and coordinate the launch of each PO wave.
* Pre-screen and review the Unfunded Quality Demand (UQD) to prioritize interventions eligible for PO funding.
* Prepare and coordinate review and decision materials for TRP review and GAC considerations of PO awards, including grant revisions.

**TRP and GAC meeting coordination**

* Coordinate the end-to-end planning of funding request and grant review cycles, including submission windows, TRP meetings and monthly GAC meetings, and manage related stakeholder communication.
* Draft agendas, prepare presentations and dashboards, and coordinate the TRP review group schedule, accounting for expertise areas and conflicts of interest.

  

**Review documentation and reporting**

* Track completion of TRP review and recommendation forms against KPI deadlines and prepare investment case analysis and presentations for each PO funding wave to support review quality.
* Document GAC deliberations and contribute to monthly GAC Reports to the Board, capturing recommendations, decisions, outcomes and key strategic issues.
* Support timely Secretariat responses to Board queries and prepare related Board and Committee analysis.
* Ensure funding request and grant documentation is complete and available on time on the TRP and GAC Extranets, troubleshooting access or content issues as they arise.

  

*Subject to change by the Executive Director at any time at their sole discretion.*

  

**Qualifications**

  

**Essential:**

* University degree in business, health, international/public affairs, economics, investment management or other relevant discipline, or equivalent professional training or work experience.

  

**Desirable:**

* Advanced university degree or qualification in global development, governance, international relations/politics or public policy or investment/portfolio management or related field.

  

**Experience**

  

**Essential:**

* Over 2 years of relevant professional experience, such as in an international organization, non-profit or private sector, with a proven track record of achievement
* Familiarity with grant-making systems and processes, including application, review and approval workflows
* Experience drafting and producing time-sensitive documents, including policies, manuals or governance documentation (e.g., briefing notes, reports, etc.)
* Experience with stakeholder- and board-level communication, including preparing briefings and materials for senior decision-making bodies
* Experience working with a variety of stakeholders (public sector, private sector, bilateral government agencies, multilateral bodies or authorities such as UN agencies, non-governmental organizations, civil society)
* Excellent relationship skills, with experience in a multicultural professional environment
* Experience working in a service-oriented, team-based setting
* Proven project management experience

**Desirable:**

* Proven experience in grant making institutions, especially in the application and review processes

* Track record of excellent written and verbal communication. Proven ability to prepare concise correspondence on a range of
* topics and ensure quality of documents.
* Track record of being a reliable, highly proactive and adaptable team member with a focus on accuracy, quality, and
* professionalism
* Proven ability to deliver results under tight timeframes and pressure
* Experience solving problems with a customer-focused approach
* Knowledge of investment or portfolio management concepts as applied to grant or program funding Demonstrated knowledge of the Global Fund and its partnership model, governance, policies and processes

  

**Competencies**

  

**Languages:**

An excellent knowledge of English. Fluency in French, Spanish or Russian would be an asset. Knowledge of other languages would be an asset.

  

**Functional Competencies:**

* Analytical (Level 2)
* Business (Level 1)
* Due Diligence (Level 3)
* Operational Policy (Level 3)
* Project Management (Level 1)

## **The future looks like you**

Seit der Gründung durch die Brüder Clemens und August im Jahr 1841 ist C&A ein Vorreiter in Sachen Mode. Von der Einführung von Konfektionskleidung, als Massanfertigungen noch die Norm waren, über die Popularisierung von Miniröcken in den 60er Jahren, die Einführung des Com-Bi-Kini in den 70er Jahren, Bio-Baumwolle Anfang 2000, bis zum ersten Cradle-to-Cradle Gold-zertifizierten Kleidungsstück im Jahr 2017 - wir sind immer mit der Zeit gegangen und haben stilvolle und hochwertige Kleidung für alle möglich gemacht. Und während sich C&A und die Welt um uns herum im Laufe der Jahrzehnte verändert haben, ist eines gleichgeblieben: unser Engagement, nachhaltige und hochwertige Mode für die ganze Familie anzubieten.   
Wir wünschen uns für die Zukunft eine Modeindustrie, die innovativer und nachhaltiger ist; eine, die sich auf eine zirkuläre Zukunft zubewegt und einen Kreislauf aus Nutzung, Wiederverwendung und Wiedergeburt von Kleidung fördert.  
In der Schweiz ist C&A mit mehr als 90 Stores vertreten und beschäftigt über 1'300 Mitarbeitende.

## **Deine Aufgaben**

* Proaktiver Kundenkontakt
* Professionelle Beratung
* Sicherstellen eines gepflegten Store-Auftritts
* Stellvertretung des Store Leaders
* Botschafter unserer Marke

## **Was du mitbringst**

* Leidenschaft für Mode und Menschen
* Flexibel in Bezug auf Einsatzzeiten
* Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit
* Eigenverantwortliche und teamfähige Persönlichkeit
* Erste Führungserfahrung als Stellvertretung wünschenswert
* Verkaufserfahrung in der Modebranche von Vorteil

## **Was wir bieten**

* Spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld
* 30% Mitarbeiterrabatt in allen unseren Stores
* 20% Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Onlineshop
* Vorteilsportal mit Angeboten von Top-Markenanbietern
* Bonus und Kompensierung von Überstunden
* 5 Wochen Ferien
* Feedbackkultur und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

title.value: Officer, Business Process Optimization & Operations - GL C - Temporary until December 2027

description.value:
Officer, Business Process Optimization & Operations - GL C - Temporary until December 2027

To support the Global Fund’s mission of ending the epidemics and to enable efficient portfolio management, Grant Management Division (GMD) must operate with robust portfolio data, clear policies and procedures, aligned business processes, and integrated systems, within a framework of continuous improvement.  
  
Within GMD, the Operational Efficiency (OE) Team is responsible for ensuring the optimization & integration of the core grant lifecycle (GLC) processes, which are at the heart of the Global Fund’s operating model and define how the Global Fund manages funding requests, makes its grants, reviews performance, disburses funds and closes grants – as such, are critical to achieving the Fund's mission. The OE team ensures the application of these processes through comprehensive (i) operational policies & procedures, (ii) system solutions & data flows (iii) change management & reporting, (iv) support provision to internal & external actors and (v) execution of defined process responsibilities.  
  
Within the OE team, the Business Process Optimization team is accountable for the development of the business process design, system solutions & data flows; change management; alignment with operational policies & procedures; and successful mainstreaming to integrate changes into business operations, support and process execution & monitoring for core GLC processes (throughout this document understood to include policies and procedures, system solutions and data flows). The team thus contributes to the delivery of the primary business of the Global Fund.  
  
The Officer, Business Process Optimization & Operations is responsible to contribute to:  
• Strong project management to support timely and quality delivery.  
• Quality diagnostics to identify opportunities for business process redesign.  
• Business process design and documentation to define business needs.  
• Systems design and user acceptance testing to ensure quality system solutions.  
• Change management and mainstreaming to facilitate integration of changes into regular business operations.  
Business process management to ensure timely and quality completion of deliverables (on demand).  
  
The Officer collaborates with a wide range of stakeholders within the Global Fund and uses strong interpersonal, communication and diplomacy skills to integrate the perspectives of different stakeholders while ensuring that the processes, policies/procedures, systems solutions, data flows and associated change management remain coherent, user-friendly, and streamlined. They are expected to systematically identify and operationalize opportunities for automation and Artificial Intelligence within their scope of work.

**Key Responsibilities**

The Officer, Business Process Optimization & Operations is responsible for the below areas of work, as assigned:

**Project Management**

* Substantively contribute to well-defined project plans, including key project deliverables, owners and deadlines, considering resource and time constraints.
* Track progress and flag potential delays and dependencies early.
* Document key decisions and open points and follow up for timely resolution.
* Identify, monitor, and support early mitigation of risks to de-risk project delivery.
* Prepare and support GLC Governance meetings, materials & documentation.

**Business Process Diagnosis, Design & Documentation**

* Analyze tickets, process data, surveys, audits, and evaluations & collect feedback from key internal and external users & relevant functional teams to identify pain points and opportunities for policy, process and/or system improvement; substantively contribute to diagnostic reports with recommendations for management decision.
* Coordinate with functional teams (Finance, MECA, Legal, etc.) and other OE teams to redesign grant life-cycle processes, building on diagnostic findings and other inputs.
* Develop and revise process maps, RACIs, forms & other process materials and ensure alignment with operational policies and procedures, significantly inputting into required updates in collaboration with the OE Policy team.
* Document requirements at an appropriate level of detail and with end-to-end process thinking in Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and other supporting assets, consulting functional teams and end users to ensure suitability of requirements and with an end-to-end view of the GLC for alignment & identification of up/downstream impacts.
* Contribute to the development of business process metrics and reporting requirements to strengthen organizational oversight, in collaboration with other teams, including the OE Business Support and Operations team.
* Define and lead projects to remedy data quality issues and ensure consistent definition of data elements and UI for clarity.
* Support scoping and prioritization exercises, including conceptualizing options, assessing business and system impacts and accounting for time and resource constraints.

**Systems Design & Testing**

* Coordinate with IT to workshop and playback solutions design, including reviewing translation of functional requirements into technical specifications, and ensuring solutions meet organizational business and reporting needs.
* Coordinate with IT, the OE Business Support and Operations team and relevant functional teams on data migration strategy, timelines and requirements.
* Lead the design & execution of UAT, including preparation & assignment of test scripts and test data, and collaborate with IT and relevant functional teams on the execution and closure of user acceptance testing to ensure quality and timely release.

 **Change Management & Mainstreaming**

* Substantively contribute to communication strategy development and change management plans based on proactive and systematic identification of user challenges, issues, knowledge and/or skills gaps.
* Develop change management materials (i.e. written communications/emails & infographics, user guidance/manuals, info sessions, clinics, etc. for internal and external business users) in coordination with functional teams and change management colleagues in OE, to increase user understanding & adoption and structurally reduce the volume of business process issues and support needs; implement change management activities as assigned.
* Use change management and communication techniques and tools as part of optimization activities to drive the right behaviours from business users, including proactively managing anticipated business milestones and peaks in business activity.
* Substantively contribute to embedding/mainstreaming process changes into the OE Business Support and Operations team.
* Contribute to ensuring sustainability by conducting thorough knowledge transfer to relevant operational teams, especially the OE Business Support and Operations team.
* Support hyper care, including escalations from support teams, root cause analyses and resolution procedures.

**Business Process Management**

* Ensure timely and quality process management for the assigned grant life cycle processes in line with the operational policies and procedures and per agreed service levels, including planning key activities triggered by Country Team demand or defined business milestones.
* Execute the assigned process steps, including defined system transactions, based on content inputs, forms, validations and approvals provided by Country Teams.
* Investigate and resolve process-related issues which are varied and non-routine, using previous experience to identify the most appropriate solution and/or enhance existing process approaches.
* Ensure and enhance data quality, including through:
    * Quality assurance review of key grant life cycle deliverables submission.
    * Review of imported information to ensure consistency and quality

At the request of Head, Managers and/or Specialists, Operational Efficiency undertake additional tasks to allow OE to flexibly respond to evolving priorities or urgent needs of the Global Fund.

*Subject to change by the Executive Director at any time at their sole discretion.*

**Qualifications**

**Essential**:

* University degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Management or other relevant area or equivalent professional training.

**Desirable:**

* Advanced degree in any of the above fields
* Qualification in project management or equivalent, or work experience in a project management/change management/business improvement capacity.

**Experience**

**Essential**:

* Professional experience in business process analysis and/or optimization, project and/or change management, ideally including in an implementing country.
* Experience with project management methodology.
* Experience coordinating between cross-divisional teams or   groups of stakeholders.
* Experience implementing organizational change using change management techniques.

**Desirable:**

* At least two to four years of relevant (post university) professional experience; Knowledge of the Global Fund and its policies, processes, procedures and IT systems
* Knowledge of Salesforce Platform
* Experience providing integrated analysis and issues resolution to business users
* Hands-on experience of Global Fund grants, within the Secretariat, as a Recipient, a Local Fund Agent or a partner organization
* International development experience, including in an international organization, non-profit or private sector an advantage

**Competencies**

**Languages:**

An excellent knowledge of English and preferably a good working knowledge of French.  Knowledge of other languages would be an asset.

**Functional competencies:**

* Analytical – Mastery – Level 2
* Business – Mastery – Level 2
* Country Context – Mastery – Level 2
* Multicultural Understanding – Mastery – Level 2
* Operational Policy – Mastery – Level 2
* Project Management – Expert Level 3
* Negotiations – Foundation – Level 1

**Technical competencies:**

* End-to-end process thinking, including business process improvement
* Excellent computer skills including PowerPoint, Word and Excel and AI tools
* High quality written and verbal communication skills
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills
* Change management
* Solution oriented root-cause analysis – ability to create business relevant appropriate and creative solutions

The Global Fund recruits top-tier talent for our open positions, in support of our mission to end AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria as epidemics.

Explore our vacancies and apply on the [Global Fund Careers](https://nam03.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftheglobalfund.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com%2FExternal&data=02%7C01%7CAbhashika.Mohapatra%40theglobalfund.org%7Cc01ce21313a247b11b2008d6fbd80f47%7C7792090987824efbaaf144ac114d7c03%7C0%7C0%7C636973302720418472&sdata=EQOzB9JZVmuTV9N4JTbQ%2F4SQ4m9XQ5KLJaZLXO%2Bm2TQ%3D&reserved=0) recruitment system.

More information on working at the Global Fund is available on the [Careers](https://nam03.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.theglobalfund.org%2Fen%2Fcareers%2F&data=02%7C01%7CAbhashika.Mohapatra%40theglobalfund.org%7Cc01ce21313a247b11b2008d6fbd80f47%7C7792090987824efbaaf144ac114d7c03%7C0%7C0%7C636973302720418472&sdata=7qfCgoNxcJvmkN3%2B53LulEg4k8Jp6DqaGTQL9x9%2BEAU%3D&reserved=0) section of our main website.

**Job Posting End Date**

08 November 2026  

The Global Fund is a partnership designed to accelerate the end of AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria as epidemics. As an international organization, the Global Fund mobilizes and invests more than US$4 billion a year to support programs run by local experts in more than 100 countries. In partnership with governments, civil society, technical agencies, the private sector and people affected by the diseases, we are challenging barriers and embracing innovation.

• Mitgestaltung der Wachstumsstrategie mit Blick auf grössere Projekte und Rahmenverträge

• Bautechnische Grundausbildung (Polier, Bauführer, Baumeister, oder gleichwertig), idealerweise ergänzt auf Stufe HF oder FH

Die Position bietet hohen Gestaltungsspielraum: Sie prägen die Entwicklung des Bereichs Hochbau in einer Wachstums- und Transformationsphase massgeblich mit, in einem Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und langfristiger Perspektive.

description.value:
Innosuisse, die schweizerische Agentur für Innovationsförderung, fördert wissenschaftsbasierte Innovation für die Schweiz von morgen und hilft Start-ups und KMU, die Chancen der Zukunft zu nutzen und international wettbewerbsfähig zu sein.
Um die Digitalisierung auf Stufe der erweiterten Geschäftsleitung zu verankern, hat Innosuisse die Funktion Leiter/in Digital Solutions (CIO) neu geschaffen.
Als Mitglied der erweiterten Geschäftsleitung übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für IT-Strategie, IT-Infrastruktur und IT-Betrieb von Innosuisse. Sie schlagen die Brücke zwischen Technologie und Organisationszielen, treiben die digitale Transformation voran und bauen die Einheit Digital Solutions mit den Bereichen IT Operations & Technology, Business Solutions sowie Security & Governance weiter aus.
Aufgaben

• Entwicklung einer Digitalisierungs- und KI-Roadmap, eng verzahnt mit den Zielen von Innosuisse

• Leitung von Digitalisierungsinitiativen und Transformationsprogrammen

• Verantwortung für den stabilen, leistungsfähigen und sicheren Betrieb auf Azure und M365, einschliesslich der Weiterentwicklung des Kernsystems «Innolink»

• Aufbau und Führung von Digital Solutions mit internen und externen Mitarbeitenden

• Verantwortung für IT-Budget, Investitionsplanung und Portfoliosteuerung

• Verantwortung für IT-Sicherheit, Compliance, Business Continuity und Disaster Recovery

• Steuerung externer Partner und Durchführung öffentlicher Beschaffungen (WTO)

• Vertretung der Themen Digitalisierung und IT gegenüber Geschäftsleitung, Verwaltungsrat und Innovationsrat

Qualifikationen

• Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar

• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung in einer leitenden IT-Funktion, idealerweise auf C-Level

• Fundierte Erfahrung in IT-Strategie, Digitalisierung, IT-Architektur und Transformation inklusive Change Management

• Erfahrung mit KI-Technologien und Strategien, agiler Anwendungsentwicklung und IT-Security

• Erfahrung im IT-Service- und Projektportfoliomanagement, ausgeprägtes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis

• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Beschaffungen (WTO) und der Steuerung externer Entwicklungspartner

• Strategische und unternehmerische Denkweise, pragmatische Umsetzungsstärke, hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Fähigkeit, Interessengruppen zu verbinden und Mitarbeitende für Veränderungen zu gewinnen

• Begeisterung für neue Technologien, Innovation und Forschung

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie gute Kenntnisse des Französischen oder Italienischen

Arbeitsort: Bern. Pensum 100 %.
Innosuisse bietet Ihnen

• Ein spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie zur Förderung von wissenschaftsbasierter Innovation in der Schweiz im Interesse von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft beitragen.

• Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet am Puls des Schweizer Innovationsgeschehens, in dem Sie ihr Wissen und Ihre Erfahrung einbringen und mithelfen können, dass hochinnovative Produkte und Dienstleistungen erfolgreich gefördert werden können.

Innosuisse achtet auf die unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse und Lebenserfahrungen ihrer Mitarbeitenden und fördert deren Vielfalt. Chancengleichheit geniesst höchste Priorität, und Innosuisse verpflichtet sich, die berufliche Integration von Personen mit Behinderungen zu fördern.
Haben wir Ihr Interesse an dieser anspruchsvollen Führungsaufgabe geweckt? Dann freut sich Herr Arnold Marty auf Ihre vollständigen elektronischen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

Innosuisse, l’Agence suisse pour l’encouragement de l’innovation, soutient l’innovation fondée sur la science pour la Suisse de demain et aide les start-up et les PME à saisir les opportunités de l’avenir et à être compétitives à l’échelle internationale.
Afin d’ancrer la numérisation au niveau de la direction élargie, Innosuisse a créé la nouvelle fonction de Responsable Digital Solutions (CIO).
En tant que membre de la direction élargie, vous assumez la responsabilité de la stratégie, de l’infrastructure et de l’exploitation informatiques d’Innosuisse. Vous faites le lien entre la technologie et les objectifs de l’organisation, faites avancer la transformation numérique et poursuivez le développement de l’unité Digital Solutions avec les domaines IT Operations & Technology, Business Solutions ainsi que Security & Governance.
Vos tâches

• Élaboration d’une feuille de route en matière de numérisation et d’IA, étroitement alignée sur les objectifs d’Innosuisse

• Direction d’initiatives de numérisation et de programmes de transformation

• Responsabilité d’une exploitation stable, performante et sûre sur Azure et M365, y compris le développement du système central « Innolink »

• Développement et direction de Digital Solutions avec des collaboratrices et collaborateurs internes et externes

• Responsabilité du budget informatique, de la planification des investissements et du pilotage du portefeuille

• Responsabilité de la sécurité informatique, de la conformité, de la continuité des activités et de la reprise après sinistre

• Pilotage des partenaires externes et conduite des procédures de marchés publics (OMC)

• Représentation des thèmes de la numérisation et de l’informatique auprès de la direction, du conseil d’administration et du conseil de l’innovation

Votre profil

• Diplôme d’une haute école en informatique, électrotechnique, sciences de l’ingénieur, informatique de gestion ou dans un domaine comparable

• Plusieurs années d’expérience de direction dans une fonction informatique dirigeante, idéalement au niveau C

• Solide expérience en stratégie informatique, numérisation, architecture informatique et transformation, y compris la gestion du changement

• Expérience des technologies et stratégies d’IA, du développement agile d’applications et de la sécurité informatique

• Expérience de la gestion des services informatiques et du portefeuille de projets, solide compréhension de la gestion d’entreprise

• Idéalement, expérience des marchés publics (OMC) et du pilotage de partenaires de développement externes

• Esprit stratégique et entrepreneurial, sens pragmatique de la mise en œuvre, excellentes aptitudes à la communication

• Capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes et à rallier les collaboratrices et collaborateurs au changement

• Enthousiasme pour les nouvelles technologies, l’innovation et la recherche

• Très bonnes connaissances de l’allemand et de l’anglais ainsi que bonnes connaissances du français ou de l’italien

Lieu de travail : Berne. Taux d’occupation : 100 %.
Innosuisse vous offre

• Un environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique, dans lequel vous contribuez à l’encouragement de l’innovation fondée sur la science en Suisse, dans l’intérêt de l’économie et de la société.

• Un champ d’activités varié au cœur de l’innovation suisse, où vous mettez à profit vos connaissances et votre expérience et contribuez à ce que des produits et services hautement innovants soient soutenus avec succès.

Innosuisse tient compte des besoins et des expériences de vie variés de ses collaboratrices et collaborateurs et encourage leur diversité. L’égalité des chances est une priorité absolue, et Innosuisse s’engage à promouvoir l’intégration professionnelle des personnes en situation de handicap.
Cette exigeante fonction de direction a éveillé votre intérêt ? M. Arnold Marty se réjouit de recevoir votre dossier de candidature complet en cliquant sur le bouton de candidature de cette page.

It’s more than just lines of code; we are looking for a commercially-minded Full Stack Engineer who can bridge the gap between user needs and business goals. You will have the ability to build resilient, cost-effective solutions and navigate evolving market demands.

You will be working in our B2B team alongside our product, delivery, and engineering teams, defining, refining, building, and measuring the impact of the solutions you implement. At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're hiring Machine Learning Engineers across our core ML engineering and horse racing teams. You'd be designing, building and productionising ML pipelines, tooling, visualisation, frameworks and data engineering workflows to support strategy research, analysis and development, working closely with our quantitative research teams to turn prototype trading models into production-ready systems. You'd also help shape the high-level architecture of our strategy software so it scales effectively and keeps trading latency low. We operate a hybrid Python/C++ engineering stack. A large portion of our stack is Python-based (utilising libraries like NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, Polars, Ray, Plotly, and Dash), but an increasing amount of our most performance-critical systems are written in modern C++ (C++23). We are actively looking to expand our team's C++ expertise to drive these low-latency components forward.

The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering background with a track record of building and maintaining production-grade ML pipelines. We are looking for engineers who are comfortable designing robust data engineering workflows, building reliable tooling, and writing clean, maintainable Python code alongside high-performance C++ components. You should be proficient in modern Python ML libraries while bringing solid C++ expertise to optimize our performance-critical architecture. Knowledge of common ML algorithms is a plus, but your primary strength should be in software design, performance optimization, and productionisation.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Our interview process is as follows:

* Intro call (30 mins) - learn more about your background + discuss the role
* Technical interview - Python & C++ software engineering assessment
* Full assessment day (10:00–5pm) - a one day programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team

**Requirements**

* A degree in a quantitative, technical subject (e.g. Machine Learning, Maths, Physics, Computer Science etc) from a top university
* Strong software engineering background in Python alongside solid expertise in modern C++ (C++23)
* Experience building, optimizing, and integrating low-latency performance-critical components in a hybrid Python/C++ environment
* Strong experience designing and maintaining ML pipelines and data engineering workflows
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as CI/CD, containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and automated testing
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP or Azure)

* Comfortable working in a Linux environment

Nice to have:

* Advanced data engineering experience in Python, e.g. with libraries like Dagster, Prefect etc
* Experience optimising dataframe code, e.g. in Pandas or ideally Polars
* Experience of machine learning techniques and related libraries and frameworks e.g. scikit-learn, Pytorch, Tensorflow etc
* Experience deploying and serving ML models in production, including model monitoring and real-time inference
* Experience in scientific computing with other languages & frameworks
* Strong general high performance computing (multi-threading, networking, profiling and optimisation)
* Familiarity with Python data science tools and frameworks (e.g. NumPy, PyTorch, Polars)

**Benefits**

* Participation in the company bonus scheme.
* 10% matched pension contributions
* Private healthcare insurance
* Long term illness insurance
* Gym membership

Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology and trading expertise has shaped QRT’s collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.

We're looking for a C++ Quantitative Developer to join our global ETF Market Making team. Working closely with quantitative researchers and traders, you'll help build and enhance the technology that powers our market making strategies. This is an opportunity to develop high-performance trading systems while gaining exposure to pricing models, execution algorithms and electronic trading in one of the most competitive areas of the market. The team trades a diverse range of instruments across markets in APAC, EMEA and the US.

Your future role within QRT:

* Designing and developing high-performance C++ applications supporting ETF market making and electronic trading
* Building and enhancing pricing, quoting, and execution components across the trading stack
* Working closely with quantitative researchers to implement and optimise trading models and algorithms
* Developing market data infrastructure and improving the performance and reliability of trading systems
* Analysing system behaviour and identifying opportunities to improve latency, throughput, and resilience
* Collaborating with traders to deliver technology that supports live trading and rapidly evolving market requirements

Your present skillset:

* 3+ years' experience developing high-performance applications in modern C++
    

* Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and multithreaded programming
* Experience developing software on Linux platforms
* Solid understanding of low-latency systems and performance optimisation techniques
* Interest in quantitative finance, electronic trading, or market making
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with researchers, traders, and engineers

QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

Job Description

The role holder’s primary responsibility will be to provide expert technical legal support to the P&C Business Unit’s EMEA teams covering P&C Treaty, Alternative Solutions (working with the dedicated Alternative Solutions (EMEA based) counsel) and Single Risk Underwriting Teams, with a focus on delivering comprehensive, reasoned and commercially viable contracting support, including wordings support.
The role holder will be required to handle phase 2 sanctions clearance (low volume/high expertise) referrals in respect of complex sanctions and compliance issues ensuring compliance with SCOR’s commitment to rigorously observe all applicable sanctions and compliance related obligations.
The role holder will be expected to provide effective legal support for the development, build out and subsequent maintenance of the P&C element of SCOR’s proposed wordings tools.
The role holder will be expected to comprehensively understand and timely respond to (as is appropriate) the commercial and business-related constraints and pressures on the SCOR P&C business unit and its growth targets whilst effectively mitigating the associated risks to SCOR.

Under the direction of the Chief Legal Counsel (P&C Business Unit) and other P&C Legal Team members, the role holder will be responsible for:
Negotiation:
Participate in negotiations of complex legal issues with external business partners and providing practical and pragmatic advice and support to the P&C business community on the negotiation of commercial terms.

Product Development:
Provide legal support for product development and the entry into any new lines of business, notably by providing contractual support to P&C treaty and specialty underwriters (e.g., policy/contract wordings, program agreements/business, third-party administrator agreements, non-disclosure agreements, etc.). Accountable for legal aspects of product development and market entry (working with the regulatory team as required).

Training:
Developing and leading training to the underwriter community.

Lex II & Contract Wording:
Providing the required legal support and expertise to support the development and roll-out of the P&C sections of SCOR’s contract wording tool, in coordination with P&C leadership and the P&C Legal community.

Monitoring, identifying, understanding, analyzing, and proactively developing P&C’s contract wording responses to emerging (re)insurance issues and trends, requiring an awareness and understanding of global developments and trends.

Regulatory & Best Practice:
Responsible for overcoming legal and regulatory challenges by Developing viable solutions to legal and regulatory “road blocks” to facilitate the P&C business unit’s delivery on its business plans and targets.

Identifying required protocols and guidelines and developing and where required supporting the development of protocols and guidelines to be embedded into the P&C business unit to ensure there are institutional best practices.
Handling phase 2 sanctions clearance referrals for complex sanctions and compliance issues. Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable sanctions and regulations.

Reinsurance and Legal knowledge: Extensive recent (re)insurance contract wording and legal support experience and superior technical skills are required.

Communication skills: Excellent written and oral communication skills, the ability to determine how and when to develop/sustain a message and/or an idea and the ability to deploy the right tools to present information.

Business acumen and accountability: A deep understanding of P&C business drivers and the ability to identify and raise critical issues/points when needed; a willingness to “own” and to swiftly correct (if needed) decisions; and, accepting and actioning responsibility regarding cost management.

Advanced Problem-Solving: Exhibiting advanced problem-solving capabilities by handling highly complex and critical legal issues with significant impact on the P&C Business Unit – involving providing and implementing innovative and effective solutions – after appropriate approvals – to mitigate risks, support business growth, and ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

Work autonomy: An ability to operate autonomously, with guidance from the Chief Legal Counsel and team peers. A proven self-starter who takes the initiative and can act independently make their own decisions, while keeping relevant stakeholders advised and involved and operating within internal governance requirements and guidelinesCommercial acumen and risk mitigation: The role holder will be commercial and pragmatic and will understand the impact of market conditions on treaty and direct (specialty) insurance activities, procedures and wordings, while being able to clearly and succinctly articulate issues to the underwriting community (and management), to evaluate the risks associated with the (re)insurance activities and to develop commercial risk mitigation options, while ensuring all operations are compliant with applicable regulatory requirements.

Stakeholder Management: Demonstrating the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders and external partners. This includes effectively communicating complex legal concepts, understanding stakeholder needs, and providing tailored legal solutions that support the P&C business unit’s objectives.

Enthusiasm: The role holder will be enthusiastic about: supporting the activities of the P&C Business Unit globally and across all business activities; working directly with the business and driving legal issues to completion; and providing general support across all areas of the Legal and Compliance functions for P&C as time and experience permits.

Collaboration and living the SCOR values: Both the P&C business and Legal teams are small, such that collegiality, efficiency, proactivity and curiosity as well as living the SCOR values are key to the role holder’s success.

Several years demonstrated experience in this field

Required Education
Strong academic record. A law degree / undergraduate degree with a law conversion qualification / equivalent.

Licensed to practice law in an EMEA jurisdiction and in good standing / the ability to immediately reactivate membership.

Note: non-lawyers will be considered too, provided they demonstrate strong expertise delivering comprehensive, reasoned and commercially viable contract wording support.

As a leading global reinsurer, SCOR offers its clients a diversified and innovative range of reinsurance and insurance solutions and services to control and manage risk. Applying “The Art & Science of Risk,” SCOR uses its industry-recognized expertise and cutting-edge financial solutions to serve its clients and contribute to the welfare and resilience of society in around 160 countries worldwide.

Working at SCOR means engaging with some of the best minds in the industry – actuaries, data scientists, underwriters, risk modelers, engineers, and many others – as we work together to find solutions to pressing challenges facing societies.

As an international company, our common culture is defined by “The SCOR Way.” Serving both to build momentum that drives the Group forward and as a compass to guide our actions and choices, The SCOR Way is anchored by five core values, reflecting the input of employees at all levels of the Group. We care about clients, people, and societies. We perform with integrity. We act with courage. We encourage open minds. And we thrive through collaboration.

SCOR supports inclusion and the diversity of talents, and all positions are open to people with disabilities.

The Opportunity
JUXT is partnering with a Tier 1 investment bank on a major Fixed Income eTrading platform, where new systems are being built from the ground up in Rust .
The platform covers two core electronic trading workflows:
- Pricing & Distribution – RFQ platform and electronic quoting
- Hedging & Algo – automated hedging and algorithmic trading

The programme is modernising a legacy C++ application and replacing it with a modern, low-latency Rust platform.
We are looking for a Senior C++ Engineer with genuine low-latency electronic trading experience to help design and build this next-generation platform.
The Role
This is a hands-on engineering position focused on building high-performance, low-latency trading infrastructure .
You will bring strong C++ and electronic trading expertise while working with Rust to develop new capabilities across pricing, RFQ, quoting, hedging and algorithmic trading.
The role requires a deep understanding of what makes systems fast and predictable. You will be expected to apply principles such as mechanical sympathy, efficient memory layout, concurrency, lock-free techniques and disciplined performance measurement .
This is not a role where latency is estimated or assumed — it is measured, profiled and continuously optimised.

Essential functions
Key Responsibilities
- Design and build new low-latency eTrading systems in Rust .
- Apply established C++ low-latency engineering principles to a modern Rust platform.
- Develop functionality across:
- RFQ and pricing
- Electronic quoting
- Hedging
- Algorithmic trading
- Design systems for predictable and consistent latency .
- Profile and measure system performance to identify optimisation opportunities.
- Apply low-level performance techniques around memory, concurrency and CPU efficiency.
- Develop reusable components that can be shared across the wider trading platform.
- Work closely with the bank's eTrading engineers, architects and trading stakeholders.
- Take ownership of technical problems from initial design through to production.
- Help replace and modernise functionality within the existing legacy C++ trading platform.

Qualifications
Essential Requirements
C++
- Strong commercial C++ engineering experience .
- Extensive experience building low-latency systems .
- Strong understanding of modern C++ and performance-focused development.
- Experience working with complex, production-grade systems.

Electronic Trading
- Proven experience developing electronic trading systems .
- Experience operating and supporting production trading platforms .
- Understanding of the performance, reliability and correctness requirements of trading technology.

Low-Latency Fundamentals
Strong knowledge of areas including:
- Mechanical sympathy
- Memory layout and allocation
- CPU/cache efficiency
- Concurrency
- Lock-free programming
- Performance profiling
- Latency measurement
- Performance optimisation

Rust
- Commercial Rust experience , or
- Strong enthusiasm and ability to learn Rust, backed by excellent C++ fundamentals.

Engineering Approach
- Able to take ownership of technical problems and drive them through to delivery.
- Comfortable designing solutions independently.
- Strong communication skills.
- Able to collaborate effectively with engineers, architects and trading stakeholders.
- Comfortable working in a technically demanding environment with a high degree of autonomy.

You will work closely with experienced eTrading engineers and the trading business, with the autonomy to design solutions and influence the direction of the new platform.

This is a rare opportunity to build low-latency trading infrastructure from the ground up .
You will take hard-won C++ and electronic trading expertise and apply it to a modern Rust technology stack, helping create a new platform without being constrained by an existing legacy architecture.
The programme provides the opportunity to influence technical design, develop reusable components and build production-grade Fixed Income eTrading capabilities across pricing, distribution, hedging and algorithmic trading.
You will also join JUXT , a premium software consultancy recognised for engineering quality and delivering complex technology programmes across financial markets.

We are looking for a senior engineer who combines:
Strong C++ + genuine low-latency expertise + electronic trading experience + a willingness to embrace Rust.

description.value:
C++ Developer – High Frequency Trading (HFT Systems)

Join MARGO in the UK (London) – High Performance Trading Environments

MARGO is a tech-native consultancy delivering elite software engineering expertise to the most demanding financial markets environments.
We operate in latency-critical trading contexts where performance, determinism and predictability are core system requirements. Our consultants work in highly specialised trading environments, designing systems that interact directly with exchanges and market venues under extreme time constraints.

Business Context

You will join a High Frequency Trading / Low Latency Trading environment within one of our partners (investment banks, proprietary trading firms or market makers).
The teams design, build and operate latency-sensitive trading systems directly connected to exchanges, typically deployed in colocated environments.
These systems are characterised by:
· Microsecond to sub-microsecond latency constraints
· Deterministic and predictable execution paths
· Minimal software and network overhead
· Direct interaction with market data feeds and order gateways

Role Overview

We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to work on latency-critical trading infrastructure.
The role is strongly engineering-driven and focuses on speed, predictability and control of execution rather than functional feature delivery.
Depending on the environment, the role may also involve interaction with C# components used outside the ultra-latency-critical execution path.

Key Responsibilities

Core HFT Engineering
· Design, develop and optimise ultra-low latency C++ trading components
· Work on critical execution paths for market data processing and order routing
· Implement lock-free and wait-free algorithms
· Optimise memory allocation, cache locality and CPU utilisation
· Reduce jitter and tail latency

System-Level & Hardware-Aware Optimisation
· Analyse and optimise CPU behaviour (branch prediction, cache misses, NUMA effects)
· Work closely with infrastructure and network teams on kernel bypass and user-space networking
· Profile systems at instruction-level and hardware-counter granularity

Production Ownership
· Ensure correctness, determinism and stability of production trading systems
· Participate in production releases and live deployments
· Investigate latency regressions and production anomalies
· Maintain rigorous operational discipline

Use of C# (Non-Critical Path)
C# may be used outside the latency-critical execution path for:
· Monitoring and control tooling
· Configuration and orchestration services
· Risk guards, limits and kill-switch mechanisms
· Real-time dashboards and operational analytics

C# is not used on the execution path and does not replace core C++ expertise.

Technical Environment

Core Technologies
· Modern C++ (C++17/20)
- Lock-free programming
- Custom memory allocators
- Zero-copy architectures
· Linux (advanced / low-level understanding)
- CPU pinning
- Huge pages
- NUMA architectures
· Networking
- TCP / UDP market data feeds
- Multicast
- Kernel bypass technologies (DPDK, Solarflare Onload or equivalent)

Latency & Performance Tooling
· CPU profilers and hardware performance counters
· Packet capture and latency measurement tools
· Exchange simulators and market data replay tools

Required Experience & Skills

Essential
· Strong experience in C++ development for performance-critical or low-latency systems
· Proven background in HFT or ultra-low latency trading environments
· Deep understanding of CPU architecture, caches and memory models
· Strong knowledge of concurrency, memory ordering and Linux internals
· Experience working close to hardware and network layers
· Strong production mindset and sense of ownership

Highly Valued
· Exposure to C# in trading, control or monitoring systems
· Experience with market data feed handlers or order gateways
· Prior exposure to market making or proprietary trading environments
· Experience with FPGA-assisted or hybrid architectures

Why Join MARGO

· Access to elite HFT and ultra-low latency trading environments
· Technically extreme and intellectually demanding engineering assignments
· Clear separation between execution-critical and supporting systems
· Human-sized consultancy with very high technical standards
· Long-term positioning on rare, high-value low-latency engineering skillsets

Important Note
This role is not suitable for candidates with a C#-only background.
Core execution systems are implemented in C++.

Please note - We do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Interested? Motivated? Apply on our website or at staff.uk @margo.com

description.value:
**DRW** is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. **DRW** is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

**DRW** is looking for an outstanding Senior Software Engineer with an expertise in C++ and previous management experience to work in our London office. In this role, you will be a part of our Core Infrastructure team which is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining DRW's low latency trading platform which is deployed global.  You will be tasked with working on various areas of the technical stack including order routing, market data, and risk systems.

**To qualify for this role, you:**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience working developing high-availability systems in C++ with very tight resource/latency constraints
* Have a background in multi-threaded programming and a strong understanding of hardware/software interaction
* Are comfortable working “under the hood” and you are quite skilled in performance tuning (applications, Linux, socket I/O, etc.) and troubleshooting
* Have experience working with C++ libraries like STL and Boost
* Are up to date on the C++23 standards and have opinions about them
* Have worked on challenging projects that involved things like building a custom compiler, writing a matching engine, or working with large amounts of data in real time
* Have had previous managerial responsibility
* Have strong English verbal and written communication skills

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Experience working in the trading industry or another ultra-low latency sensitive business that involves solving remarkably complex problems
* Experience working with Research teams and Quants
* Experience working within gaming or streaming

**For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at [https://drw.com/privacy-notice](https://drw.com/privacy-notice).**

**California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at [https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice](https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice).**
